title: Director for Development
description:
Job Description

For over 160 years, the University of Washington has been a hub for learning, innovation, problem solving and community building. Supporting this legacy and important public mission—with the goal of making the UW the world’s greatest public university, as measured by positive impact—guides everything we do in University Advancement. Bringing together development; alumni and stakeholder engagement; marketing and communications; and advancement operations, we advance the UW’s impact by developing meaningful connections that foster pride, advocacy and philanthropic support.

The University of Washington Tacoma is a growing, urban-serving university that is deeply invested in its local and regional community. As one of three campuses of a world-class university, UW Tacoma is dedicated to innovative teaching, scholarship and to engaging the community in mutually beneficial partnerships and collaborations. UW Tacoma’s commitment to diversity and accessibility for all is central to an environment where students, staff, faculty and South Sound residents find abundant opportunities for intellectual, personal and professional growth.

UW Tacoma has an exciting opening for a Director for Development. This is a full-time permanent position.

The Director for Development is a front-line fundraiser responsible for developing and executing strategies to solicit gifts of greatest impact in support of the University of Washington Tacoma. Reporting to the Associate Vice Chancellor for Development, this position partners with Deans, faculty, academic and student affairs leaders, and volunteers to plan and sustain gift identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship efforts. The Director for Development is accountable for directing fundraising initiatives for assigned schools, units, and programs.

What You Will Do:

Frontline Fundraising (70%)

  • Manage a portfolio of philanthropic prospects, focusing on identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding donors who have the capacity to make major gifts.

  • Identify and qualify new donor prospects using research tools, donor information, and professional networks, including prospects interested in planned giving.

  • Engage donors and prospects through meaningful interactions, primarily face-to-face, and translate those conversations into clear, actionable cultivation and solicitation plans.

  • Prepare, submit, and follow through on major gift proposals, including solicitations of $100,000 or more, aligned with fundraising priorities.

  • Work within an established fundraising metrics and accountability framework, managing activity levels, proposals, progress toward goals, and reporting regularly on results.

  • Work collaboratively with advancement colleagues across the University to coordinate donor engagement, prepare briefing materials, and support solicitation efforts.

  • Prepare proposals, gift agreements, and supporting materials in coordination with advancement and gift services colleagues, ensuring accurate documentation and timely donor acknowledgment.

  • Engage volunteers and advisory board members, when appropriate, to support fundraising and donor relationships.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date donor records and participate in prospect tracking using the University of Washington’s donor database.

  • Stay informed about fundraising priorities and work with campus leaders and advancement colleagues to support gifts for both immediate and long-term impact.

Strategy and Program Development (25%)

  • Develop and lead fundraising strategies for assigned schools, units, and academic and student affairs programs, using best practices to meet established goals; provide strategic guidance to shape and advance philanthropic priorities.

  • Create and implement an annual fundraising plan that outlines clear goals, strategies, and priorities, and track progress throughout the year.

  • Design and carry out development programs and targeted fundraising initiatives that support sustained and increased philanthropic support.

  • Regularly evaluate fundraising programs, assess progress toward goals, and share clear updates on outcomes and impact.

  • Effectively communicate and advocate for UW Tacoma’s mission, priorities, and funding needs to donors and community partners.

  • Represent UW Tacoma at donor engagements, campus events, and relevant professional gatherings.

  • Support marketing and communications efforts by identifying compelling stories and opportunities that highlight fundraising priorities and impact.

Other duties as assigned (5%)

Required Qualifications:

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Requirements:

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications will not be forwarded to the Hiring Department.

A bachelor’s degree AND five (5) years of experience in development/advancement, with an emphasis on frontline fundraising, stewarding and soliciting major gifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in major gift fundraising, with a strong understanding of the full donor engagement process, including identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

  • Proven ability to build and maintain donor-centered relationships based on trust, credibility, and long-term partnership.

  • Experience working toward clearly defined fundraising goals and activity metrics, with the ability to track progress, manage performance expectations, and use data to inform strategy.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to navigate differing perspectives and resolve conflict through open, respectful dialogue.

  • High ethical standards and sound judgment, with a commitment to integrity, transparency, and responsible fundraising practices.

  • Effective critical thinking and decision-making skills, particularly in complex or evolving situations.

  • Familiarity with donor databases and fundraising systems.

Working Conditions:

  • Hybrid-work schedule with four days in the office and one day eligible for telework per week.

  • Cubicle/open workspace environment that may result in higher noise levels and visual distractions.

  • Ability to work evening and weekend hours, as necessary, on short or limited notice.

  • Access to regular and reliable transportation for local travel.

Overview:


AvalonBay Communities, Inc., an equity REIT, has a long-term track record of developing, redeveloping, acquiring and managing distinctive apartment homes in some of the best U.S. markets, and delivering outsized, risk-adjusted returns to shareholders. Creating a better way to live is the purpose that binds AvalonBay associates. We take that purpose seriously and expect you will as well. The Role:

Superintendent II will assist more senior Superintendents on the day-to-day responsibilities of multi-family residential and mixed-use construction projects from start to finish. Superintendent II will take responsibility and manage several components of the project.

  • Identifies root causes of hazards, delays, poor quality, and other jobsite issues. Develops solutions and plans that mitigate future risk to the project

  • Monitors subcontractors designated by Project Superintendent, Senior Superintendent, and/or General Superintendent and supervises work performance, productivity and schedule

  • Collaborates with Project Superintendent, Senior Superintendent, and/or General Superintendent and Project Manager on a consistent

  • Basis to review construction schedule and identifies what needs to be revised and updated

  • Ensures all aspects of quality control standards are met (Including but not limited to framing, roofing, finishes, etc.)

  • Attends regularly scheduled daily and weekly project team meetings as appropriate

  • Creates, sends out, tracks, and monitors request for information (RFIs)

  • Assists with daily inspections with sub code officials.

  • Maintains daily onsite activities such as sign in for subcontractors and the ProCore daily log

  • Provides general direction and oversight to the safe performance of work that meets required quality standards and the established time and scope in the project plan

  • Enforces safe work practices and safe working conditions in accordance with all municipal, state and federal regulations. Ensures compliance with AvalonBay safety and health program requirements and project specific Safety and Health Plan

Education:

  • High school diploma OR equivalent (GED) required

  • Construction-related courses from a vocational or technical school preferred

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of comparable work related experience in residential construction projects with moderate knowledge related to all disciplines and phases of construction

  • Reads and writes English as demonstrated by clear and concise written and verbal communications

  • Ability to perform computer applications such as Unifier (I-BEAM), ProCore, and Blue Beam. Ability to use Microsoft Office applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Project, and Excel

  • Possesses strong leadership skills with demonstrated ability to plan, prioritize, organize, collaborate, and manage workloads

  • Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with a diverse range of personalities, ability to keep calm under pressure, ability to communicate effectively and ability to multitask

  • Demonstrates analytical and problem solving skills

  • Understands all aspects of the plans documentation package

  • Exhibits familiarity with building codes and local jurisdiction policies and procedures

We know that our teams are the beating heart of our success and we’re committed to showing our appreciation.


We offer:


  • Comprehensive benefits — health, dental and vision, 401(k) with company match, paid vacation and holidays, tuition reimbursement, an employee stock purchase plan and more. Click on Benefits (https://jobs.avalonbay.com/benefits) for information.
  • Growth based on achievement and promotion from within.
  • Associate recognition (a company-wide recognition program that celebrates associate efforts and successes in contributing to the overall success of the organization – including destination awards, ‘AvalonBay’s Very Best’ recognition program and others!).

title: Rehabilitation Consultant | Provisional Psychologist or Rehab Counsellor
description:
GET TO KNOW ALTIUS

Altius was founded in 2001 with a vision to bring high-quality and compassionate rehabilitation services into the market to improve lives displaced by injury. Since then, we've branched out to cover three tiers of services including Workplace Services, People and Employee Services, and Disability Services - still driven by a single goal: to elevate the wellbeing of people, workplaces and communities across Australia.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US?

Unleash your potential:

  • You will join a market leader with over 20 years' experience of supporting people on their wellbeing journey
  • With multiple division and locations across Australia there are opportunities expand your horizons into new areas
  • Take control of your career development and progression pathway!
  • Support and training to empower you to manage your caseload effectively

A place to be you:

  • You will join a team-orientated culture where we value Individuality and recognize your unique skills and contributions.
  • Large & supportive multidisciplinary team - corporate and social events!
  • At Altius, you are welcomed to join our D&I committee, which was set up to champion diversity and inclusion.
  • We support you to acknowledge culturally significant days or events by accessing 3 days of Cultural Leave per annum.

Requirements

YOUR NEW ROLE

Working from our Newcastle office, this opportunity will see you identify and address the critical physical, psychological, social, environmental and organisational risk factors which may have an impact on a worker's ability to successfully return to work and provide strategies to address these factors in practise.

  • Complete return to work case management for injured workers under the WorkCover scheme.
  • Provide holistic support to help restore an individual's highest level of functional performance through relevant assessments such as:
    Initial Needs Assessment, Functional Capacity Evaluations, Workplace Assessments and Vocational Assessments.
  • Deliver Vocational Counselling and facilitate interventions, well-being programs, training and upskilling.
  • Collaborate and liaise with individuals, employers, medical and other allied health professionals.

WHAT YOU NEED TO JOIN US

  • Associate or Full ASORC membership as Rehabilitation Counsellor OR AHPRA registration as Provisional or Registered Psychologist
  • Minimum 1-2 years experience working in Occupational Rehabilitation
  • Relevant Psychology or Rehabilitation Counsellor qualification
  • Current drivers' licence and access to own transport

HOW TO APPLY

If Altius sounds like a place to be you click 'Apply Now'.

If you would like to have a confidential conversation before applying or if you're interested in a career with Altius but this role is not right for you, please call contact Monique on 0424 804 685 or email: MMarques@altius-group.com.au.

Altius is an Equal Opportunity Employer and an inclusive workforce. Research has shown that, in Australia, women, people living with disability, LGBTQIA+, First Nations people, and those from minority groups are less likely to apply for a role because they feel they will not be successful. We believe in the strength of diversity and inclusion, and we would like to strongly encourage those who identify with any of these groups to apply for a role with us.

title: Systems Specialist
description:
High Point University is seeking a Systems Specialist of Information Technology. This position is responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise level applications that support critical university operations and instructional services. The Specialist will be required to support or implement multiple applications and data integrations while maintaining a highly available environment and conforming to established change management protocol. Documenting known issues, solutions, configuration items, data integrations, and system information will also be required. The System Specialist will work within the Enterprise Application Services Team and is charged with actively supporting each team member and their initiatives.
QUALIFICATIONS:

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience

  • 2-5 years of progressive experience supporting enterprise level applications and services (ex. ERP, HRM, LMS, CMS, etc.)

  • 1-3 years’ experience with Database, Web, or Application programming

  • Experience with one or more computer languages (C#, PHP, SQL, SSIS, etc.)

  • Experience with Colleague, Blackboard Learn, Blackboard Transact highly desirable

  • Experience creating ETL packages and XML transforms

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work creatively in a problem-solving environment

  • Excellent verbal and written communication; technical writing

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Systems Administration/Support

  • Serves as Primary System Administrator for university Student Self-Service and Business Intelligence (Reporting) systems.

  • Serves as Secondary System Administrator for university ERP and Portal.

  • Analyzes system logs to detect/prevent performance issues.

  • Performs annual audits of system access.

  • Provides level 2 technical support for enterprise systems.

  • Monitors, tracks, schedules, and performs system upgrades/patches in accordance with OIT Change Management Process.

  • Manages and monitors SQL Server and MySQL database backups.

  • Performs quarterly SQL Server and MySQL database backup restore tests.

  • Documents all system configurations and data integrations using defined standards within 3 business days of approved changes.

  • Develops and maintains data flow diagrams and system inventories.

Development

  • Designs, develops, tests, and implements well-formed, sustainable, and documented code structures that support defined business requirements.

  • Designs, develops, tests, and deploys system data integrations to automate manual/repetitive processes in accordance with EAS team and OIT department standards.

Consultancy/Customer Service

  • Works with users and OIT teams in problem analysis, solution identification, implementation, and delivery activities.

  • Works closely with OIT teams and end users to understand project requirements and recommend sustainable solutions that meet defined business and academic needs.

  • Serves as technical contact for ERP and CRM data systems and enterprise applications.

  • Responds to assigned user support requests within 1 business day.

  • Diagnoses and resolves at least 90% of assigned Help Desk tickets within 3 business days.

  • Achieves and maintains a 99.9% user satisfaction rating on follow-up surveys.

Information Processing & Decision Making

  • Prioritizes allocation of time and resources in accordance with defined priorities as communicated by Manager.

  • Actively look to maximize existing university investments and leverage existing systems to solve identified business problems.

  • Actively look to eliminate repetitive manual processes.

  • Identifies potential impacts of new systems/processes or changes to existing systems/processes and guide implementation to ensure operational reliability.

  • Coordinates with other OIT staff, functional users, and appropriate vendors to account for security (physical and logical), sustainability, disaster recovery, and business continuity measures in all solutions.

Communication

  • Interprets meaning and importance of information. Determine appropriate need and method for keeping team members, users, stakeholders, and management informed.

  • Utilizes plain language in all verbal and written communication.

  • Keep systems, process, testing, and training documentation updated using defined standards within 3 business days of approved changes.

  • Documents systems and processes in accordance with defined standards.

  • Be engaged and participates in individual discussions, project and team meetings.

Planning and Organizing

  • Works with OIT Management and teams to establish appropriate project timelines to deliver sustainable solutions within approved time and budget parameters.

  • Independently manages assigned tasks and project components.

  • Demonstrates attention to detail in all phases of the system lifecycle and application management.

Problem Solving

  • Establishes working partnerships with business units and OIT teams to coordinate problem resolution for operational issues and analyze root cause issues to address underlying system/process problems.

  • Works with the OIT User Support Services team to identify common issues and develops appropriate documentation, training, and/or tip sheets for campus users.

  • Coordinates with users, OIT teams, and vendors to resolve system and/or operational issues.

For more information about this position, please contact Jonathan Luther, Director for Data Center Services at jluther@highpoint.edu.

title: Football PMO Director
description:
Job Title: Football PMO Director

Company: Hawk-Eye Innovations Ltd

Location: London/Basingstoke

Reporting to: Managing Director, Football

Role Overview:

This is one of the most important leadership roles within Hawk-Eye Football. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, the Football PMO Director is responsible for building a world-class delivery organisation capable of executing strategic priorities, customer programmes and technology deployments across the global football business.

The role will establish and lead the Football PMO while acting as the Managing Director’s strategic delivery lead, ensuring strategic priorities are translated into successful execution. The Football PMO Director will anticipate issues, solve complex operational problems and ensure that the organisation consistently delivers to world class standards.

Key activities that the role will focus on:

  • Lead strategic cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the Managing Director, taking ownership from concept through execution and ensuring delivery against agreed business outcomes

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing delivery organisation through coaching, mentoring and clear accountability

  • Own the prioritisation, governance and health of the Football delivery portfolio

  • Continuously improve delivery governance, tools, methodologies and ways of working to increase organisational effectiveness

  • Deliver customer implementations, technology deployments and strategic business initiatives

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the successful delivery of Football's strategic initiatives, customer projects and technology programmes.

  • Maintain executive ownership of major and business-critical programmes.

  • Establish effective delivery governance, reporting, accountability and portfolio management across Football.

  • Own delivery planning and pipeline management, ensuring leadership has clear visibility of progress, risks and priorities.

  • Lead, coach and develop Project Managers, Programme Managers and Technology Delivery Managers, building a high-performing delivery function.

  • Own the delivery budget and contribute to the successful commercial delivery of new projects.

  • Partner with Commercial during customer discovery, due diligence and bid activities to ensure deliverable, well-planned solutions.

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Global PMO to ensure new technologies are successfully developed, tested, deployed and transitioned into live operation.

  • Represent Delivery within Product Steering, ensuring product roadmaps remain aligned to customer and operational priorities.

  • Drive continuous improvement across delivery processes, governance, tools and organisational effectiveness.

Skills/Knowledge Required:

Essential:

  • Significant leadership experience within sports technology, enterprise technology or similarly complex operational environments.

  • Proven track record delivering complex technical programmes at scale.

  • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • First-class problem-solving ability, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Excellent judgement and decision-making.

  • Highly adaptable, proactive and comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate issues, prioritise effectively and drive outcomes.

  • Experience leading, developing and motivating high-performing delivery teams.

Preferred:

  • Experience within sports data, officiating technology or large-scale technology services.

  • Broad understanding of end-to-end technology delivery, from product development through operational deployment.

  • Knowledge of cross-functional business operations including Product, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Operations and PMO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Hawk-Eye is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all
employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion,
age, disability, or union membership status. We value diversity and strive to create an
environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

Apply Today!
This is a fantastic opportunity to join Hawk-Eye Innovations and make a significant impact in sports technology. If you're looking for a role where you can solve real-world problems at scale, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Hardware Development Engineer
description:
Hardware engineers develop, improve, and maintain custom solutions supporting the reverse logistics refurbishment processes and test networks supporting Arvato’s global customers.

  • You independently develop hardware components and construct e.g. housings and functional components.
  • You provide the layout for electronic circuits.
  • The structure of the control electronics, including the wiring and networking of electronic components, is a matter of course for you.
  • You program the control electronics and develop hardware-related software.
  • You conscientiously follow the continuous development, optimization and testing of the devices.
  • Developing and maintain test hardware that contains: steppers/servos/controllers, linkages/arms/actuators, microcontrollers, Arduino, raspberry pi, Linux commands.
  • PC and network knowledge, windows management, imaging, networks, USB device troubleshooting, router/network setup, TCP/IP knowledge.
  • Electrical troubleshooting of PCB’s and panels, AC/DC knowledge, use of multimeter, various sensors like, proximity switches, microphones, cameras.
  • Mechanical knowledge, use of hand/power tools, assembly/disassembly, identifying physical wear issues.
  • Travel: As needed outside the US on project teams
  • Office/Warehouse: Fully onsite
  • Associates in electrical engineering, mechatronics or a comparable qualification
  • Broad-based basic electrical engineering knowledge, sound specialist knowledge in the fields of analogue and digital technology, embedded microcontrollers and EMC-compliant design and layout as well as knowledge of robotics, prototype construction, 3D printing, precision engineering, sensor technology and mechatronic disciplines
  • Knowledge of programming in C, C++, C# and firmware development desirable
  • Analytical skills, creativity, passion for development, initiative, strong communication and teamwork skills and ability to adapt quickly to the needs of the departments
  • Knowledge of CAD, Fusion 360, MS office products.
  • Performing variety of duties as required
  • Flexibility Based on Business Needs: work overtime, holidays, weekends, different shifts, and different areas of the warehouse
  • The ability to create instructions, processes, and procedures.
  • Multilingual in Spanish and/or German, a plus
  • SAP experience, preferred
  • Ability to Commute: Louisville, KY
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Disability Pay.
  • 401(k) with company matching up to 6%.
  • Paid Time Off, including paid holidays.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts.
  • Voluntary benefits such as legal and financial assistance, pet insurance, and more.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Ongoing employee development opportunities including tuition reimbursement, scholarships, and training.
  • Commuter benefits.
  • Employee engagement activities.

· Troubleshoot / Problem solving beyond method defined action

· Good Communication

· Familiar with good laboratory techniques

· Experience working with Cell Culture in biological operations or testing setting preferred.

· Experience in use of root cause analysis tools

· Experience using SAP

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

In Product and Design, we bring together product managers, product designers and service designers in a central team covering the breadth of Faculty’s Applied AI division. In partnership with our Business Units, we form multidisciplinary teams and work with data scientists, engineers and delivery colleagues to create durable AI-powered software solutions for clients across a variety of industries.

Both product management and design are critical disciplines to create impact with AI. While data science and machine learning offer a powerful means to build insight and predictive capability, those insights are often consumed within a complex operational environment where human and organisational factors determine whether solutions are adopted and ultimately successful.

Closing the gap between the outputs of a model and the outcomes desired by our clients requires us to go beyond data and technology to address the human side – product and design are critical to this.

About the role

As a Principal Product Manager at Faculty, you will own and develop the Product Management discipline within Applied AI while driving transformational client outcomes. You will establish modern product capabilities, skill frameworks, and delivery standards that enable teams to build durable, AI-powered products. Working directly with client executives, you will help organisations navigate complex technology adoption and maximise business value. This dual-impact role blends high-leverage strategic client work with building a fast-growing, entrepreneurial product practice from the ground up.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning and advancing the product management discipline across Applied AI by setting organisational standards and modern best practices.

  • Performing senior billable consulting work on key client engagements to guide the team approach, framing, and product execution.

  • Advising enterprise clients on product management structures, operating models, and technology adoption strategies.

  • Shaping skill frameworks that directly inform hiring plans, team capability building, and line management across the product practice.

  • Partnering with business development leads during early engagement phases to help clients turn advanced AI models into viable long-term products.

  • Educating internal teams and client stakeholders on the strategic value of product management in driving commercial outcomes.

Who we're looking for

  • You bring a solid track record in product management leadership, with experience building capabilities or teams in fast-paced or scale-up settings.

  • You demonstrate strong consulting acumen and stakeholder management skills, capable of guiding non-technical executives through complex product choices.

  • You have hands-on experience delivering complex data, analytics, or AI-powered products that solve tangible business problems.

  • You bring an agile, pragmatic approach to problem-solving, focused on getting things done while building long-term organisational capability.

  • You carry an entrepreneurial mindset and excellent communication skills, passionate about articulating the value of product management to clients and peers.

  • You enjoy split accountabilities, seamlessly transitioning between capability development, high-impact client delivery, business development, and team mentorship.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

Since then, we've branched out to cover three tiers of services including Workplace Services, People and Employee Services, and Disability Services - still driven by a single goal: to elevate the wellbeing of people, workplaces and communities across Australia.


WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US?

Unleash your potential:

  • You will join a market leader with over 20 years' experience of supporting people on their wellbeing journey
  • With multiple division and locations across Australia there are opportunities expand your horizons into new areas
  • Take control of your career development and progression pathway!
  • Support and training to empower you to manage your caseload effectively
  • Above award salary, generous bonus scheme, benefits, annual salary review.
  • Recognition of our people through national social award events & office-based awards.
  • Leadership training, mentoring, and guidance offered to reach your goals.

Requirements

Requirements

As a Rehabilitation Consultant, you will play an instrumental role in facilitating the recovery and rehabilitation of individuals who have experienced injury, illness, or disability.

Your clinical expertise and guidance will be pivotal in supporting individuals regain independence, improve their quality of life, and reintegrate into the community and the workforce.

  • Develop personalised rehabilitation plans that support a whole-of-person approach to rehabilitation
  • Complete a range of assessments including Functional Capacity Evaluations, Workplace Assessments, Ergonomic Assessments and Activities of Daily Living Assessment (ADLS).
  • Use lateral thinking and forward planning skills to identify potential return to work pathways in line with likely recovery milestones
  • Utilise problem-solving skills, clinical experience, and knowledge of injury management to perform assessments and facilitate the return to work of claimants
  • You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders, including clients, their families, insurance companies, employers and other healthcare professionals to evaluate physical, psychological, and social factors
  • Present case information to various stakeholders and providing credible recommendations/solutions to drive the desired goal

WHAT YOU NEED TO JOIN US

  • A tertiary qualification in Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapist or Exercise Physiology
  • Full registration with AHPRA or ESSA
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Current driver's license and car

Benefits

If Altius sounds like a place to be you click 'Apply Now'.

If you would like to have a confidential conversation before applying or if you're interested in a career with Altius but this role is not right for you, please call Monique Marques on 0424 804 685 or email mmarques@laltius-group.com.au

Altius is an Equal Opportunity Employer and an inclusive workforce. Research has shown that, in Australia, women, people living with disability, LGBTQIA+, First Nations people, and those from minority groups are less likely to apply for a role because they feel they will not be successful. We believe in the strength of diversity and inclusion, and we would like to strongly encourage those who identify with any of these groups to apply for a role with us.

title: AI Architecture Specialist II
description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that drives opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate in diverse markets, including financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and others. Experian invests in people and cutting-edge technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an incredible team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is valuing yours. Experian's people-centered, inclusive, and purpose-driven culture is recognized by numerous awards — including World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Top 25 global by Fortune) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers website to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an employer that promotes equal opportunity and affirmative action.

Job Description

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Solution Architect – AI to lead the architectural strategy of Artificial Intelligence-based solutions, driving the company's technological transformation through modern, scalable, and data-driven architectures.

This professional will be responsible for defining reference architectures for Generative AI, Machine Learning, and intelligent agents solutions, connecting business needs to the organization's technological capabilities. They will serve as the primary technical reference in strategic initiatives, influencing engineering, architecture, product, and executive leaders in the adoption of innovative solutions.

We expect a professional with solid experience in enterprise architecture, software development, Cloud platforms, and Artificial Intelligence, capable of leading high-complexity initiatives and accelerating the company's technological evolution.

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead technically the definition of architecture for Artificial Intelligence-based solutions;

  • Define architectural strategy for Generative AI applications, intelligent agents, and cognitive automation;

  • Act as the primary technical consultant for strategic initiatives involving AI;

  • Work together with Engineering, Product, Data, Security, and Enterprise Architecture in defining high-impact solutions;

  • Evaluate and select foundational models, frameworks, and AI platforms according to technical, regulatory, and business requirements;

  • Define architectural patterns for applications based on LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, and AI platforms;

  • Ensure that solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, governance, observability, and operational efficiency;

  • Lead Architecture Reviews, Design Reviews, and Technical Assessments for AI projects;

  • Provide technical support to multiple engineering teams throughout the entire solution lifecycle;

  • Conduct proof of concepts (POCs) and technology evaluations for new AI capabilities.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Solid experience in enterprise architecture and solution architecture;

  • Microservices Architecture;

  • Domain Driven Design (DDD);

  • Event Driven Architecture;

  • API First;

  • Distributed architectures;

  • Integration between enterprise systems;

  • Cloud Native Architectures;

  • Event-driven architectures;

  • Platform-based architecture (Platform Engineering);

  • Definition of corporate architectural patterns.

IT WILL BE A DIFFERENTIAL

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certification;

  • Azure AI Engineer Associate;

  • Google Professional Cloud Architect;

  • TOGAF;

  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD);

  • Knowledge in MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker Pipelines);

  • Experience with corporate AI platforms and model governance;

  • Participation in technical communities, events, or Open Source projects related to AI.

Additional Information

Serasa Experian is much more than you imagine. With the purpose of creating a better future, expanding opportunities for people and businesses, in Brazil we have more than 4,000 people working in diverse teams and specialties. Here, every knowledge and diversity complement each other and you can work on what you love most. We are committed to building an inclusive culture and an environment in which people can balance their careers with their personal commitments and interests, prioritizing well-being.

We are very dedicated to being one of the best and most innovative companies to work for in the country, enabling incredible experiences and careers for our people. Our strong people-first approach is recognized externally through various market certifications: we have been awarded by Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries and by the international Top Employers certification, and we are recognized as one of the best companies for young professionals with a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor. Each recognition indicates that we are on the right path, providing an increasingly better work environment for our talents.

title: Specialist, Program Management
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Specialist, Program Management

Job Code: 41971

Job Location: Cincinnati, OH

Schedule: Employees work 9 out of 14 days with every other Friday off

L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing diverse, high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

About L3Harris Technologies:

L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet customers’ mission-critical needs. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries.

L3Harris Defense Electronic Systems (DES), a division of L3Harris, provides precision electronic components, subsystems, and systems for the DOD and international allies. L3Harris DES specializes in the design and manufacture of fuzes, ignition safety devices, proximity sensors, GPS navigation systems, aerospace status indicators, and range and test solutions.

Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, L3Harris DES’ primary manufacturing facility was specifically designed and constructed for the manufacture of fuzing and ordnance systems and precision electronic components. L3Harris is a partner you can count on to deliver quality products and solve your toughest technical challenges. The Cincinnati location has flexible manufacturing - capable of manufacturing a variety of products from large scale down to individual production units for development efforts, dual identical modern Surface Mount Technology (SMT) assembly lines for automated electronic manufacture, and on-site inspection and test capabilities to perform all required environmental conditioning test

procedures. We offer competitive benefits, an alternative 4/10 work schedule, and the opportunity to work with a talented and diverse group of professionals.

Job Description:

L3Harris Fuzing and Ordnance Systems, located in Cincinnati, OH is the established leader in Fuze, Ignition Safety Device, and Height of Burst Sensor development and manufacturing for DoD weapon systems. We are seeking a Specialist Program Manager that must understand project management processes and have experience leading small to mid-sized projects involving developing technology and products and manufacturing of hardware to meet customer requirements. This position will have profit and loss responsibility and overall authority to lead a matrix team of engineers and operations staff to execute one or more DoD weapon safety device development or production contracts. The Program Manager will typically spend their time; 80% on development of new or manufacturing of existing fuzing and ordnance products, 10% developing proposals for new or follow-on contracts, and 10% on personal and organizational improvement and growth. We offer competitive benefits, an alternative 4 day / 10 hour work week, and the opportunity to work with a talented and diverse group of professionals focused on warfighter success and safety … What We Do Matters.

Essential Functions:

· Lead Program Team

· Manage Cost, Schedule and Technical Performance

· Ability to develop and maintain project documentation, to include: Integrated Master Schedule, Procurement Plans, Quality Plans, Engineering Plans

· Demonstrated Ability to supervise the execution of project Plans in a Matrix environment, particularly Engineering, Supply Chain and Operations/Manufacturing.

· Experience effectively managing risk and opportunities.

· Act as customer point of contact responsible for meeting contractual commitments including the cost, schedule, technical, and quality performance of assigned projects and program(s) within contractual boundaries, company expectations, and established standards.

· Establish program strategy, vision and tactical direction for program execution by project team

· Track program performance to integrated master schedule, identify program issues and obtain solutions, such as allocation of resources or alternate technical approaches.

· Experience organizing and leading Project Status Review meetings and cost analysis with stakeholders. Review project status and budget; manage schedules and prepare status reports for customers and senior management

· Experience Developing Proposal Bid Strategies, Developing Proposals, Leading the development of Estimates at Complete (EACs) and providing input to the Annual Operating Plan. Coordinate the preparation of proposals, proposal work statements, specifications, and program budgets.

· Ability to obtain a Secret Clearance.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior program mgmt related experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.

· A minimum of 2 years of experience in contributing to business growth by referring new business opportunities to Sales and Management, assisting with proposals, conducting customer-facing presentations, and other support initiatives.

· A minimum of 2 years of experience with program/project management or comparable experience in lead roles demonstrating project/program management skill sets, preferably on DoD weapons or safety-critical product development contracts.

Preferred Additional Skills:

· PMP Certification or equivalent.

· Strong communication and organizational skills

· Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, MSProject)

· Proficient in Earned Value Management

#LI-WN1

L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. L3Harris is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, characteristic or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local laws. AvalonBay Communities, Inc., an equity REIT, has a long-term track record of developing, redeveloping, acquiring and managing distinctive apartment homes in some of the best U.S. markets, and delivering outsized, risk-adjusted returns to shareholders. With equal parts experience and vision, we’ve established a leadership position rooted in our purpose of creating a better way to live and that is always focused on building value for the long term.


Creating a better way to live is the purpose that binds AvalonBay associates. We take that purpose seriously and expect you will as well. By focusing on collaboration, innovation, and taking ownership of our choices and actions, we act in ways that focus on creating value for our customers, investors and associates. Your positive, professional, and consistent personal interactions make AvalonBay a great place to work.


The Role:

Are you ready to be a part of an extraordinary leasing team and revolutionize the apartment living experience? At AvalonBay Communities, we don't just manage properties; we pioneer exceptional living experiences. If you're an accomplished office professional with a passion for innovation and a vision for excellence, your next career move is here.


AvalonBay Communities is searching for a dedicated and highly organized Leasing Consultant to take on the daily operations of the leasing team at one of our apartment communities and ensure our residents experience nothing short of luxury living. • Incredible customer service skills. You have a knack for creating a sense of community and the drive to go the extra mile to create a spectacular experience for new residents. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build.

You have

• A high school diploma or equivalent (GED) required
• 1-2 years of experience in a leasing or customer service role, preferably in the real estate or property management industry
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills
• Proficiency in using property management software and Microsoft Office Suite
• Knowledge of fair housing laws and regulations
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

We know that our teams are the beating heart of our success and we’re committed to showing our appreciation.

  • A 20% discount on our incredible apartment homes.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


About the team

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

About the role

As a Lead AI/ML Engineer at Faculty, you will set the technical direction for complex AI/ML projects, ensuring models perform at scale and in production over time by balancing technical trade-offs and guiding team priorities.

You will lead the delivery of large-scale AI-powered platforms in high-risk environments while defining project roadmaps across multiple complex workstreams.


This is an ambitious, entrepreneurial leadership role where you will act as a trusted technical expert, defending your architectural rationale to senior stakeholders to ensure we deliver high-quality, high-value outputs.

What you'll be doing:

  • Setting the technical direction for complex software projects to ensure architectural decisions support long-term product and client goals.

  • Driving the development of shared software libraries and microservices that accelerate delivery across multiple client engagements.

  • Overseeing the delivery of large-scale AI-powered platforms while defining project roadmaps in high-risk environments.

  • Facilitating alignment between ML, Data Science, and DevOps crafts to ensure agentic software is built on a reliable foundation.

  • Managing and coaching a distributed team of engineers, setting development goals that align with organisational growth.

  • Establishing enterprise-wide standards for code delivery, testing, and system documentation across the software engineering craft.

  • Leading hiring processes for the software engineering craft to continue building a world-class technical team.

Who we're looking for:

  • You apply deep expertise across the application lifecycle to set high standards for system integration and end-user software quality.

  • You design large-scale, complex software ecosystems with the authority to justify critical architectural trade-offs in high-stakes environments.

  • You define the gold standard for production readiness, establishing application deployment protocols across diverse client engagements.

  • You translate high-level commercial strategy into technical roadmaps, ensuring AI work-streams are accurately estimated and seamlessly integrated.

  • You architecturally direct the development of products leveraging autonomous AI agents to ensure they are robust and effectively integrated.

  • You are a confident communicator, capable of conveying complex technical roadmaps and architectural risks to commercial partners and executive leadership.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the Hiring Manager (30 minutes)

  3. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  4. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

title: Career Advisor (Full-Time)
description:
High Point University is seeking a full-time Career Advisor in the Career and Professional Development department, working with students in most majors supporting them in their professional pursuits of future internships, employment, or advanced degrees. This position will also be the lead Career Advisor on our Internship Guarantee program working closely with students and our Director of Corporate Relations.

For additional information regarding this position, please contact the Vice President, Doug Hall, dhall1@highpoint.edu.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

  • Master’s degree in counseling, higher education administration/student development, or related field

Experience and Training:

  • One to two years of career counseling or related experience, preferably experience in career development in an institution of higher education
  • Preferably one to two years of experience working in a recruitment or selection function in an organization

Knowledge, Skills, Ability:

  • Knowledge of organizational recruitment and selection strategies to maximize potential of students to attain high-quality internships and jobs
  • Excellent interpersonal and verbal communication skills; ability to build rapport with students and faculty
  • Outstanding professional communication and writing skills
  • Strong presentation, technology, and social media skills; active presence on LinkedIn
  • Familiarity with Handshake software system preferred
  • Familiarity with WordPress software preferred
  • An exemplary “can do” attitude that will lead to excellent customer service
  • A commitment to being a team player who adjusts to changing work environments and organizational priorities

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Assists students with the exploration of appropriate career options, career development, internship and job search advising through individual career counseling appointments and group settings
  • Administers career-related assessments and assist students in interpreting results, including but not limited to StrengthsFinder, CareerLeader, and other assessments pertaining to one’s personality, interests, values, and workplace preferences; certification for assessments preferred but not required
  • Helps students determine the most appropriate fit for an academic major/minor and related careers
  • Prepares students to apply to competitive graduate schools, providing assistance with application process, personal statement and C.V. development, and interview preparation
  • Coaches students on how to develop and leverage a professional resume and LinkedIn profile
  • Assists students with internship and job search process, facilitating professional networking with alumni; disseminate employment and internship opportunities to appropriate faculty and students

  • Teaches career exploration and relevant business courses

  • Develops general knowledge and understanding over time of the related professions and opportunities represented by HPU majors and maintains familiarity with education, training and career opportunities and expectations
  • Learns existing and develops programming that strengthens students’ preparation for internships, graduate school, and full-time jobs
  • Analyzes data about use, interest, and value of presentations, one-on-one appointments, and programs
  • Represents HPU as needed during special events, including Family Weekends, Orientation, and Early Registration that may occur on nights and/or weekends
  • Works closely with the faculty across campus and Career & Professional Development staff members in planning of employer development activities including employer visitations, job fairs, career programs on-campus recruiting, and the development of job and internship leads

  • Reports to Assistant Director of Career and Professional Development

title: Principal Scientist
description:
The Opportunity

SE7

As a Principal Scientist in Small Molecule Biomarkers (Metabolomics & Lipidomics) within our Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) team, you will play a key role in advancing safe and effective therapeutics for patients. Joining Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), you will empower drug discovery across the organization by developing high-throughput mass spectrometry workflows and applying modern tools—including Generative AI—to drive biological insights.

Key Responsibilities:

● Method Development: Design and apply LC-HRMS and LC-MS/MS methods to acquire high-quality mass spectrometry biomarker data supporting drug discovery and development.

● Experimental Execution: Prepare and execute global and targeted metabolomics and lipidomics protocols across diverse biological specimens, including biofluids, tissues, and cells.

● Data & AI Workflows: Perform mass spectrometry data processing and statistical analysis; build or leverage Generative AI tools and software workflows to scale analysis and reporting.

● Quality & Insight: Oversee rigorous bioanalytical quality control using common industry practices and critical analytical reasoning.

● Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with multidisciplinary teams and project stakeholders to translate complex omics data into actionable drug target research.

Who You Are

You are an innovative analytical scientist with a passion for cellular metabolism, mass spectrometry technology, and emerging computational tools. You thrive in collaborative, high-impact environments and want to translate cutting-edge omics data into life-changing medicines.

Qualifications & Experience:

● Education & Industry Experience: PhD in biological, chemical, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field, accompanied by 3–5 years of direct experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

● Bioanalytical Expertise: Proven experience designing and executing assays for endogenous small molecule metabolites or lipids, including sample preparation techniques like precipitation, liquid-liquid, or solid-phase extraction.

● Technical Mastery: Practical experience operating and troubleshooting modern LC-MS platforms (e.g., UHPLC, triple quadrupole, high-resolution mass spectrometers) and using analytical data processing software.

● Metabolic & Computational Insight: Solid foundation in cellular metabolism, coupled with hands-on experience or strong aptitude using Generative AI tools for coding and biological insight generation.

● Collaboration & Communication: Excellent communication skills with a proven track record of working effectively in multidisciplinary project teams.

Relocation benefits are available for this posting.

Her significant experience for 25 years in healthcare management and pioneering work with over 400 peer-reviewed publications have earned Chi Longevity global recognition, as evidenced by the extensive media coverage in publications such as the Financial Times and Business Insider.


Chi Longevity is a fast-growing company with ambitious goals, offering a unique and exceptional opportunity to join a team dedicated to optimising clients' health and slowing down their biological ageing. As a key addition to our team, you will have the chance to contribute to our mission and be a part of this exciting and transformative journey.

Location: Singapore

Hours: Full-time, 5.5 days per week

Reports to: Chief Medical Operating Officer


Role Summary: We are looking for a confident, articulate, and highly capable Senior Clinic Administrator to oversee day-to-day operations across our Singapore facilities. This is a full-time, on-site role for someone who takes pride in precision, leadership, and delivering a seamless, five-star experience for every client.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can hold the fort independently when needed, step up without being asked, and collaborate seamlessly as part of a multidisciplinary team. Given our predominantly international clientele, you must be polished, well-spoken, and at ease engaging with multinational guests from diverse cultural backgrounds.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a growing, forward-thinking clinic at the frontier of longevity and preventive health

  • Take ownership of clinic operations and team leadership as the business scales

  • Work alongside a passionate multidisciplinary team of physicians and health specialists in a boutique, high-touch environment

  • Engage with a sophisticated, international, high-net-worth clientele who value excellence and discretion


Key Responsibilities:

Client Experience & Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for our international clientele — managing inquiries, feedback, and escalations with poise, cultural sensitivity, and professionalism

  • Oversee patient flow, appointment scheduling, and front-of-house operations across clinic locations, ensuring every touchpoint reflects our standard of excellence

  • Coordinate closely with the clinical team to support seamless care delivery

  • Support the onboarding and coordination of health screening packages and wellness programmes

  • Coordinate client meals and manage the overall client experience end-to-end

Administration & Compliance

  • Oversee administrative processes including medical records management and billing

  • Maintain accurate documentation while safeguarding confidentiality and supporting compliance with data protection and healthcare regulations

  • Manage medical and non-medical inventory, and liaise with vendors and external partners

  • Manage pantry and stationery ordering, ensuring clinics are well-stocked at all times

  • Support reporting and contribute to initiatives that strengthen service quality and reputation

Team & Process Leadership

  • Run clinic operations independently when required, demonstrating sound judgment and decisiveness without constant oversight

  • Proactively identify and resolve operational issues before they escalate — we value initiative over instruction

  • Optimise workflows and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and client experience

  • Lead, support, and collaborate with the clinic team, fostering a culture of accountability, warmth, and excellence

  • Take ownership of ad-hoc projects and initiatives as the clinic grows

Requirements:

  • Relevant diploma or degree in healthcare administration, business administration, or a related field

  • Prior experience in clinic or healthcare facility management strongly preferred

description:
Experiencing together a unique human adventure

Plant Controller

Virbac Animal Health is seeking a Plant Controller for our Finance Team. The Plant Controller plan, organize, direct and control the accounting of the results of the industrial operations’ activities, including reporting of the operational results and ensuring that adequate internal controls exist and are complied with in the industrial operations area. This role drives and improves the industrial operations control tools of Virbac Corporation in order to measure and analyze the performance of the industrial operations’ activities to ultimately improve costs and manufacturing efficiencies, invested capital optimization and internal control effectiveness.

Qualified candidates should have experience in the following:

  • 8-12 years working in a Manufacturing Environment

  • Strong Cost Accounting background (Product Costing and Inventory valuation, BOM management and development).

  • ERP system familiarity –Inform M3 a plus

  • Ability to work cross functionally to drive results

This exciting position will work in Bridgeton, MO. It comes with an excellent benefits package including generous time off, 401k + match, life, medical, dental, and vision benefits, and more!

Area of responsibility 1: [Monitoring of Industrial Operations activity].

Main activities

  • Participate in the monitoring of the industrial operations activity through financial and operational reporting, consistently evaluate and analyze performance, and provide reliable decision making tools, including but not limited to, manufacturing variance and the inventory valuation.
  • Contribute to the optimization of production costs by supporting production management in quantifying and analyzing production measures.
  • Oversee inventory valuation, preparation of the monthly inventory reserve analysis, and roll-forward of inventory reserve.
  • Validate internal controls on a regular basis to ensure that controls remain appropriate and effective.
  • Oversee the physical inventory count process including implementation and maintenance of a perpetual inventory count process that meets internal and audit requirements (thus transitioning the company away from an annual physical inventory count).
  • Forecast and model activity-levels, taking into account financial, technical, planning and production aspects.

Expected results: Optimization of Industrial Operations’ activities

Area of responsibility 2: [Reporting of Industrial Operations activity]

Main activities

  • Provide the reporting required to and to analyze and control the performance of the Industrial Operations activities: Purchasing, Planning, Manufacturing, Inventory, Logistics, and Investments.
  • Analyze the performance of industrial processes in collaboration with operational management by producing relevant reports and indicators
  • Report and analyze the manufacturing variance in partnership with finance and operations.
  • Define production costs to ensure consistency, accuracy and appropriate tracking.

Expected results: Improved Industrial Operations’ performance

Area of responsibility 3: [Manage standard cost system].

Main activities

1. Manage and Monitor the standard cost system in the framework of the VB Group cost methodology including the following related activities:

a. Refining the applied methodology and ensuring that it is consistently applied

b. Calculate, analyze and report item costing and manufacturing information for the annual budget process.

  • Prepare standard cost budgets taking into account:
  • Manufacturing volumes relates to budgeted sales volumes
  • Direct labor hours and related budgeted costs
  • Overhead absorption rates based upon manufacturing volumes and budgeted indirect manufacturing cost
  • Over/under absorption of manufacturing overheads
  • Material standards

c. Validate and approve all changes to standards

  • Calculate and simulate standard and actual production costs including estimated production cost of new products.

d. Accounting for, analyzing and reporting on variances between actual and standard costs

Expected results: Standard Costs are relevant and reasonably represent valid costs.

Area of responsibility 4: [Management of STL Accounting]

Main activities

  • Provide leadership for the STL accounting staff through proper control, support, supervision, coordination and training.
  • Establish policies and procedures with regards to manufacturing accounting.

Expected results: STL Accounting operates efficiently and effectively on behalf of the Company

Area of responsibility 5: [Other]

Main activities

  • Assist in projects linked to information systems and tools implementation.

Expected results: Effective tools related to Industrial Operations

Profile

Requirements (Diploma and experience)

  • Accounting Degree required – CPA or CMA preferred
  • 8-12 years experience in a manufacturing environment with at least 5 years experience in a management capacity.

Skills

  • Managing Standard Costing Systems in Manufacturing Environment.
  • ERP experience, preferrably Infor M3 Movex.
  • Cross Functional Communication and Partnership.

We are looking for a Senior Android / Mobile Warehouse Apps Engineer to design, build, maintain, and improve mobile applications used in warehouse and operational workflows. This role will focus on Android-based mobile applications, ruggedized / warehouse devices, barcode or camera-driven workflows, backend API integration, reliable field performance, and practical support for UAT and production rollout.

This is a senior hands-on engineering role. Working hybrid from our Singapore office. The engineer will work closely with Product / Delivery Managers, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, backend engineers, QA, DevOps, and warehouse / operations users. The role does not own formal people management, but it is expected to provide senior technical judgment, mentor other engineers where needed, and help define mobile engineering standards for GEO.

The right candidate should be comfortable working with business-critical mobile workflows where usability, speed, reliability, offline behavior, device compatibility, and release quality directly affect warehouse and operations teams.

Mobile / Warehouse Focus:

The primary focus of this role is Android and warehouse-facing mobile applications. Cross-platform experience is useful, but the first priority is strong Android engineering capability for operational workflows, warehouse devices, scanning, image capture, API integration, and reliable deployment to business users.

Insight on Your Impact:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and improve Android mobile applications used in warehouse and operational environments.
  • Build reliable mobile workflows for scanning, receiving, picking, packing, inventory, image capture, user validation, and other warehouse or field use cases.
  • Integrate mobile applications with backend APIs, internal platforms, ERP-related systems, and other business-critical services.
  • Optimize mobile application performance, stability, readability, and speed for real warehouse and field conditions.
  • Design and support offline-capable or poor-connectivity workflows, including local storage, sync logic, retries, conflict handling, and user-friendly error handling.
  • Support ruggedized Android devices, barcode scanners, camera workflows, device permissions, app configuration, and mobile deployment processes.
  • Work with Product / Delivery Managers to clarify mobile requirements, user workflows, acceptance criteria, UAT feedback, and rollout priorities.
  • Work with Product Group Team Leads / Architects and backend engineers to define API contracts, data flows, authentication, error handling, and technical dependencies.
  • Work with QA to define mobile test coverage, regression scenarios, device testing needs, and release readiness criteria.
  • Support production troubleshooting for mobile application issues, including device-specific problems, API failures, performance issues, sync failures, and user-impacting defects.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and define practical remediation actions for mobile production incidents or recurring defects.
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical documentation.
  • Help improve mobile engineering standards, release discipline, monitoring / diagnostics, logging, and supportability across GEO.
  • Provide senior technical input for future mobile capabilities, including computer vision integration, image quality, capture workflows, and AI-assisted warehouse processes.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence:

  • 5+ years of professional mobile application development experience, with strong hands-on Android experience.
  • Strong experience with Kotlin and / or Java, Android SDK, Android Studio, Gradle, and modern Android development practices.
  • Experience building production mobile applications that integrate with REST APIs, authentication services, backend systems, and business workflows.
  • Strong understanding of mobile UI / UX principles for operational users, including speed, readability, low-friction workflows, and error recovery.
  • Experience with offline-capable mobile design, local storage, synchronization patterns, and poor-connectivity scenarios.
  • Experience troubleshooting mobile application issues across devices, OS versions, network conditions, backend dependencies, and user workflows.
  • Practical understanding of mobile security, authentication, permissions, secure storage, and data protection.
  • Experience with automated testing, manual validation, regression testing support, and release readiness for mobile applications.
  • Ability to work with Product / Delivery, QA, DevOps, backend engineering, and business stakeholders in a distributed environment.
  • Ability to work independently, make practical technical decisions, and support urgent production or UAT issues without heavy supervision.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain mobile technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High ownership mindset, good judgment, and practical problem-solving approach.

Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity:

  • Experience with warehouse, logistics, supply chain, inventory, receiving, shipping, or distribution center applications.
  • Experience with ruggedized Android devices, Zebra / Honeywell / similar scanners, barcode scanning SDKs, RFID, or camera-based capture workflows.
  • Experience with Android Enterprise, MDM / EMM tools, private app distribution, managed device configuration, or enterprise mobile deployment.
  • Experience with Jetpack components, MVVM or similar architecture patterns, Room / SQLite, WorkManager, Retrofit / OkHttp, and modern Android libraries.
  • Experience with Kotlin coroutines, background processing, push notifications, and mobile diagnostics / crash reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter, while still having strong native Android capability.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with .NET backend services, SQL Server-backed systems, ERP systems, NetSuite, or warehouse platforms.
  • Exposure to computer vision, image capture quality, image upload workflows, model integration, or AI-assisted mobile features.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD for mobile apps, automated build pipelines, and release management.
  • Background in electronic components, B2B technology, global distribution, logistics, manufacturing, or similar operational environments.

Success in the First 90 Days:

  • Establish working relationships with Product / Delivery, backend engineering, QA, DevOps, warehouse / operations users, and GEO leadership.
  • Review current mobile architecture, codebase, release process, testing approach, device deployment model, and production support gaps.
  • Identify key risks around application stability, device compatibility, offline behavior, API dependencies, performance, security, and release readiness.
