title: Business Analyst Intern - Supply Chain
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations.

Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment. Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope.

ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is a global leader in launch and space systems. We're opening access to space to improve life on Earth through our Electron rocket and Neutron launch vehicle programs, alongside our space systems business. From pioneering carbon composite rocket technology to delivering reliable and rapid launch services, we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible in aerospace.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a motivated intern to join our Supply Chain team in Auckland. As a supply chain intern, your role is to support the team in ensuring smooth operations, improving efficiency, and contributing to the overall success of the supply chain. You'll gain hands-on experience in various aspects of supply chain management while developing valuable skills for a future career in the field.

This is an opportunity to work on real space technology projects and contribute to missions that are literally reaching for the stars.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Data Analysis and Reporting:

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret supply chain data to identify trends and areas for improvement
  • Assist in preparing reports, dashboards, and presentations for supply chain performance metrics (e.g., inventory levels, delivery times, cost analysis)
  • Use tools like Excel, ERP systems, or supply chain software to organize and analyze data
  • Analyze procurement data to identify trends and insights

Process Improvement:

  • Identify inefficiencies in supply chain processes and suggest improvements
  • Support the implementation of new tools, technologies, or workflows to enhance supply chain operations
  • Participate in process mapping and documentation efforts

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with other departments (e.g., production, sales, finance) to ensure alignment of supply chain activities with business goals
  • Support communication between teams to address supply chain-related challenges

Market Research and Cost Analysis:

  • Conduct market research to identify trends, pricing benchmarks, and cost-saving opportunities
  • Assist in analyzing procurement data to identify areas for cost optimization
  • Provide recommendations for improving procurement efficiency
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute innovative ideas

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

MUST HAVE:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain or other relevant fields
  • Proficient using Microsoft Products (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, Access)
  • Proven ability to clearly communicate, manage work tasks, and provide status updates
  • Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems
  • Team oriented, strong ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment and to multiple deadlines
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and efficiently
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Passion for aerospace, space technology, and innovation

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Associate's Degree and 3+ years of Purchasing/Inventory Planning experience
  • Proficient in MRP systems
  • Prior experience in fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • Previous internship or project experience in supply chain or procurement

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Hands-on experience working on real aerospace and space technology projects
  • Mentorship from world-class engineers and industry professionals
  • Exposure to cutting-edge rocket and spacecraft systems
  • Professional development opportunities in the space industry
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Opportunity to contribute to missions that make a difference
  • Potential pathway to future career opportunities at Rocket Lab

HOW TO APPLY

Please ensure you submit a cover letter, detailing why you are interested in the specific role you have applied for. Please make sure to cite a project/experience/hobby that is relevant to the role.

Application Deadline: Friday, 28th August 2026

Please note: We will be reviewing and interviewing candidates on a rolling basis as applications are received. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as positions may be filled before the closing date.

Start Date: November 2026

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. title: Formulation & Process Development Senior Scientist
description:
Experiencing together a unique human adventure

Animal health is key to the health of the planet. Working at Virbac means taking part in a unique human adventure in which the engagement of each individual contributes to its evolution. Encouraging internal mobility between positions and countries, offering individual development plans and building a partnership based on trust between managers and employees are as many perspectives of motivation for our teams. We also offer them a work environment conducive to exploring new territories and balancing their professional and personal lives. Finally, fostering their engagement to animal health also means listening to them and helping them to acquire new skills, preparing them for the challenges of tomorrow and encouraging them to contribute to an ever more responsible approach to our business.

Virbac Animal Health is seeking a Formulation & Process Senior Scientist to join our team. The Formulation & Process Development Senior Scientist develops new and optimized existing pharmaceutical products for the animal health market. Identify and evaluate new technologies and/or formulation processes Provide technical expertise in collaboration with other functional groups to prepare formulations development plans, to help establish and meet project timelines, prepare laboratory, pilot, and industrial scale batches, and support technology transfer to Industrial operations, for a variety of product dosage forms including, tablets, liquids, powders, chews and others, in compliance with cGMP, FDA and EMA regulations/guidelines. Mentor the Junior Formulation Scientists.
Experience: BS in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Process Engineer or higher degree. 5+ years of experience in a pharmaceutical-related field is desired.
Benefits: 13 Company paid Holidays; 5 personal days (prorated); 15 vacation days (prorated); 5 floating holidays (prorated); 6% 401k match; competitive pay and bonus opportunity; growth opportunities within the department and much more!

Area of responsibility 1: Development of new pharmaceutical products or optimization of existing pharmaceutical products (R&D roadmap).

Main activities

  • Lead and support the development of novel dosage forms and manufacturing processes for the delivery of drugs to animals, for internal and subcontracted projects i.e. CMOs.
  • Prepare formulation development plans to help establish and meet project timelines.
  • Lead The Quality by Design (QbD) and Design of Experiments (DOE) approach to develop products and processes that helps identify and control critical factors that affect product quality.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Engineer - Relocate to New Zealand
description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

At Halter, we know how much farmers care - for their animals and their pasture. But the tools they rely on haven’t kept up, and we’re on a mission to change that. Halter helps farmers make smarter decisions - fast. We reckon good pasture management is the key to more productive and sustainable farms. More grass. Healthier soil. Happier animals. And more time back for the people doing the work.

About the role

We're looking for Lead Engineers who perform at the top of the craft. You'll take on the hardest problems, make the calls that matter on the gnarliest design questions, and ship work that the rest of the team learns from. Engineers around you get better because they're working alongside you. We don't mind whether your strengths sit on the frontend, backend, full stack, or on the platform side that gives every other engineer leverage. What matters is that you ship robust, thoughtful work at a level few others can match, and use AI tools well.

The kind of problems our teams solve

Halter is one system: hardware, software, and AI, running live on real farms. Our engineering teams own different slices of that system, but the problems all rhyme:

  • Turning thousands of collars and billions of sensor events into a single, calm decision in a farmer's hand.

  • Modelling the physical world (animals, pasture, terrain) accurately enough to act on in real time.

  • Building mobile and web experiences that hold up at 5am whilst out in a paddock in the rain.

  • Designing platforms and pipelines that scale with our incredible pace of growth without the seams showing.

  • Engineering against constrained hardware, flaky rural connectivity, and the messiness of the physical world, and shipping with pace despite it.

Every team here ships software that has to work in a paddock, not just a browser tab.

What you'll do

  • Take on the hardest problems and ship the work that proves them out.

  • Make the architectural calls that matter, then back them up by writing the code.

  • Set the standard for thoughtful engineering: clean, observable, easy-to-evolve code and systems.

  • Support and mentor other engineers through design conversations, code reviews, and generous context sharing.

  • Help set the pace and quality bar for engineering at Halter.

  • Help evolve our testing strategies, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure patterns.

  • Own the reliability and performance of your domain, especially when things get tricky. Every team owns its services end-to-end, with an on-call rotation.

  • Get out on farm. Deep domain knowledge matters, and you'll be expected to develop it.

You'll be great if you:

  • Have spent years shipping complex systems in production and have the experience (and scars) to show for it.

  • Stay calm under pressure, have a low ego, and can rally a team through tough or complex work.

  • Think like a product engineer: you care about the customer experience, not just clean code.

  • Know how to use AI tools well to lift team output and focus on the harder stuff.

  • Have grown other engineers by working alongside them, not by managing them.

  • Are comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where adaptability beats perfection.

  • Have worked in cloud environments. AWS is a bonus.

  • A degree in software engineering (or equivalent) is nice to have, but not essential.

Depending on where you sit on the stack, some of these will land harder than others:

  • Frontend / Mobile: strong UX intuition, modern frontend frameworks (React, React Native a bonus), an eye for performance and polish on real devices.

    Backend: building and scaling REST APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven services. Comfort with both relational and non-relational databases. Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or systems that integrate with hardware/IoT a bonus.

    Full stack: all of the above, end to end, across web, mobile, and the services that power them.

    Platform: you love building tooling that makes the whole company move faster, including the AI tooling that's reshaping how engineers work. Strong AWS and Terraform at scale, with experience across CI/CD, observability, and on-call tooling.

Our Benefits

  • Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Our Office First Approach

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.

Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.

We’re office first, not office only. This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.

Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

텍트그룹은 "The Defining Longevity Wellness Brand House"를 비전으로, 건강하고 아름답게 나이 드는 데 필요한 모든 순간을 책임지는 글로벌 소비재 기업을 목표로 합니다. Skin-activating Skincare 브랜드 SAYNID를 중심으로 한 Brand Tribe, 세일즈 채널과 그로스 레버를 운영하며 매출 성장을 가속하는 Growth Tribe, 위성계정과 전문가 네트워크를 오가닉 미디어 자산으로 키우는 Media Tribe가 하나의 플라이휠로 연결된 구조로 성장합니다. 소비재 업계에서 일의 본질에만 집중할 수 있는 완전히 새로운 조직 문화를 지향하며, AI-native 운영 시스템을 압도적인 성장의 핵심 레버로 정의하고 있습니다.

저희는 토스(toss), 온더룩(onthelook), 포터리(POTTERY), 모스트(MOST), 마이리얼트립(Myrealtrip), 랩노쉬(LABNOSH), 브레이(BRAYE) 등 그로스 마케팅과 브랜드 운영 전문가로 구성된 팀입니다. 글로벌 성장 가능성을 인정받아 법인 설립 2주 만에 kakao Ventures, BASS Ventures로부터 시드 투자를 유치하였고, 최근 빠른 성장을 바탕으로 AMOREPACIFIC, Xquared로부터 추가 투자 유치를 마무리하였습니다. 2026년 2Q 미국법인 설립을 마쳤으며, 빠른 실행의 팀과 함께 압도적인 성장을 만들고자 합니다.

[이 포지션에서 얻어가실 수 있는 것]
첫 커리어를 미국 시장에서 시작합니다. 팀원들과 함께 미국 뷰티·웰니스 시장에서 통하는 크리에이티브를 직접 만들고 지표로 검증합니다. 빠른 실행을 기반으로 가설을 세우고, 만들고, 시장에 던지고, 숫자로 답을 받습니다. 대행사나 큰 조직에서는 몇 달 걸릴 학습을 몇 주 안에 압축해서 경험합니다. 기획부터 촬영, 편집, 성과 분석까지 전 과정을 직접 경험하실 수 있는 오너십을 드립니다.

Responsibilities

텍트그룹의 콘텐츠 PD (인턴)은 인지부터 전환까지, 크리에이티브로 브랜드의 그로스를 만드는 역할입니다. 트렌드 포맷을 빠르게 캐치해 적용하는 것도 중요하지만, 우리는 그 위에 브랜드만의 오리지널리티를 쌓는 데 더 힘을 싣습니다. 콘텐츠 PD (인턴)은 콘텐츠 그로스 마케터와 함께 일하며, 처음에는 검증된 포맷의 베리에이션 제작으로 시작해 점차 본인의 기획으로 실험을 주도하는 범위까지 넓혀갑니다.

[숏폼 콘텐츠 제작]
• 자사 채널(틱톡·릴스) 숏폼 콘텐츠 촬영·편집
• 트렌드 포맷 리서치 및 브랜드에 맞게 변형해 적용
• UGC·전문가·인플루언서 촬영 어시스트 및 편집

[영상 광고 소재 제작]
• Meta·틱톡 인지/전환 캠페인용 영상 소재 제작
• 성과가 검증된 소재의 베리에이션 및 확장 소재 제작
• 마케터·콘텐츠 PD의 기획안을 영상 문법으로 옮기는 작업

[실험·검증·개선]
• 주간 성과 회고에 참여해 잘 된 포맷의 성공 요인을 정리
• 지표(조회·전환·ROAS)를 기준으로 다음 소재의 개선 포인트 도출
• AI 영상 툴을 활용한 제작 리소스 효율화 실험

모든 업무는 글로벌 시장 기준입니다.

Requirements

• 영상 기획·촬영·편집을 혼자서 완결할 수 있으신 분 (동아리, 개인 채널, 프리랜스, 인턴 등 형태는 무관)
• Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects 등 영상 제작 툴을 능숙하게 다루시는 분

• 틱톡·릴스 트렌드에 밝고, 잘 되는 콘텐츠의 패턴을 궁금해하시는 분
• 피드백을 빠르게 반영하고, 만든 결과물을 숫자로 확인하는 과정에 흥미를 느끼시는 분
• 6개월 이상 풀타임 근무가 가능하신 분

Preferred

• 글로벌 뷰티·웰니스·라이프스타일 트렌드를 매일 틱톡·인스타그램·X로 흡수하고 계신 분

• 영미권 거주 경험이 있거나, 영미권 문화·언어에 대한 이해도가 높으신 분

Benefits

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will turn model capabilities into real product behavior. You will own problems end-to-end, from shaping model behavior, to building the systems around it, to ensuring it performs reliably in production.

This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, systems, and product, focusing on making AI actually work for users, not just in demos, but in real-world usage.

Focus

  • Build and ship AI features end-to-end (model → system → user experience)

  • Design and iterate on prompts, tools, memory, and agent workflows

  • Turn raw model outputs into structured, reliable, and predictable behaviors

  • Debug issues across the full stack (model, orchestration, infra, UX)

  • Optimize for latency, cost, and production reliability

  • Develop lightweight evaluation frameworks to measure real-world performance

  • Work closely with product and engineering to translate ambiguous problems into working systems

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • LLMs (OpenAI-style APIs, LLaMA, Qwen, etc.)

  • Inference / serving (e.g. vLLM)

  • Vector DB

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundation in machine learning and modern neural network architectures.

  • Hands-on experience with training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models

  • Ability to write clean, production-quality code

  • Comfort working across abstraction layers (model → infra → product)

  • Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, latency, and reliability targets.

  • Production issues are identified quickly, debugged effectively, and root causes addressed.

  • Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are robust, reproducible, and maintainable.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineers, product, and research teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

  • Iterations on models and systems are driven by real-world signals and measurable improvements.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical AI product.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Overview:


AvalonBay Communities, Inc., an equity REIT, has a long-term track record of developing, redeveloping, acquiring and managing distinctive apartment homes in some of the best U.S. markets, and delivering outsized, risk-adjusted returns to shareholders. With equal parts experience and vision, we’ve established a leadership position rooted in our purpose of creating a better way to live and that is always focused on building value for the long term.


Creating a better way to live is the purpose that binds AvalonBay associates. We take that purpose seriously and expect you will as well. By focusing on collaboration, innovation, and taking ownership of our choices and actions, we act in ways that focus on creating value for our customers, investors and associates. Your positive, professional, and consistent personal interactions make AvalonBay a great place to work.


The Role:

This role has two salary ranges, depending on the level at which the candidate is hired:

Development Director: $132,600 - $221,000

Senior Development Director: $161,300 - $271,800

We’re looking for a Development Director / Senior Development Director to lead multiple multifamily and mixed-use projects from initial deal evaluation through stabilization. This is a hands-on role owning the full lifecycle—feasibility, entitlement, design, execution, and delivery.

You’ll work across internal teams and external partners to move deals forward, manage risk, and drive projects to successful outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

Own the project lifecycle

  • Lead projects from site evaluation through stabilization

  • Build and evaluate feasibility: entitlements, market, financials, environmental and engineering

  • Prepare investment materials and recommendations for internal approvals (MIC)

  • Manage contracts, risk, and overall deal strategy

  • Deliver clear monthly project updates

Drive execution through partners

  • Manage architects, engineers, planners, and other consultants

  • Lead design process and ensure deliverables hit scope, schedule, and budget

  • Oversee vendor selection and performance at an executive level

Lead cross-functional teams

  • Run asset teams across Development, Construction, Design, and Operations

  • Align stakeholders and keep projects moving

Navigate entitlements

  • Own the entitlement process end-to-end

  • Work directly with municipalities, land use attorneys, and consultants

  • Participate in hearings and approvals, manage timelines and risk

Source new deals

  • Identify and help advance new development opportunities

What You Bring

  • ~7+ years in real estate development

  • Direct experience running development deals—not just supporting

  • Strong understanding of entitlements, financial underwriting, and project execution

  • Proven ability to manage consultants, vendors, and internal stakeholders

  • Comfortable operating at both strategy level and in the weeds

Education

  • Bachelor’s required

  • MBA or Master’s in Real Estate (or similar) is a plus

Nice to have

  • LEED or other industry certifications

We know that our teams are the beating heart of our success and we’re committed to showing our appreciation.

  • A 20% discount on our incredible apartment homes.
  • A culture built on purpose and our core values - A Commitment to Integrity, A Spirit of Caring, and A Focus on Continuous Improvement.

title: [dusk그룹] 글로벌 마케터(홍콩, 태국, 대만)
description:
About

미디어커머스 업계를 리드하는 최고의 마케터들과 함께 일하고 싶나요?
갓 탄생한 브랜드가 100억 매출이 되기까지 직접 총괄하고, 경험할 수 있는 기회입니다.
위 모든 것을 할 수 있는 실력있는 회사, "dusk그룹"에서 글로벌 마케터를 채용합니다.

우리는
2022년 브랜드 1개, 연 매출 40억으로 시작해
2023년 브랜드 3개, 연 매출 120억 돌파
2024년 브랜드 7개와 연매출 300억을 만들어냈습니다.
2025년 브랜드 15개를 만들어가며 1,000억을 이루었습니다.
2026년은 매출 2,000억을 목표로 달리고 있습니다.

우린 이런 분들을 찾고 있습니다.
1. 브랜드의 탄생부터 완성까지 직접 총괄하고 경험하고 싶은 분
2. 성과를 낸 만큼 인정 받고, 보상 받고 싶은 분
3. 결과를 만들기 위해 집요하게 달려나갈 수 있는 분
4. 매번 동료들한테 "왜 그렇게 열심히 하는 거야?" 라는 얘기를 듣는 분
5. 지금은 부족하지만 성장의 열망을 갖고 있는 분

그리고 함께 성장을 통해
앞으로 만들어갈 15개의 브랜드의 총괄 운영자와
글로벌 마케팅 전문가에 도전하세요!

Responsibilities

[시장분석]
• 글로벌 시장 or 컨텐츠 or 경쟁사 분석 후 인사이트 도출

[인플루언서 마케팅]
• 해외 인플루언서 발굴 및 커뮤니케이션
• 시즌별 컨텐츠 / 캠페인 기획 및 실행

[퍼포먼스 마케팅]
• 메타/틱톡/구글 등 paid광고 매체 퍼포먼스 및 컨텐츠 운영
• 마케팅 전략 기획 수립 및 실행

Requirements

• 1년 이상 미디어커머스 유관 경력 혹은 이에 준하는 경험이 있으신 분
• 비즈니스 영어가 가능하신 분(영문 이메일 소통 및 리스닝 역량)

Preferred

• 틱톡샵, 해외 자사몰(shopify) 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• 해외 거주 경험 및 현지 문화 이해도가 높으신 분
• 해외 인플루언서 및 퍼포먼스 마케팅으로 성과를 낸 경험이 있으신 분

[ 이런 분께는 맞지 않습니다 ]
• 기획서만 쓰면 현지 대행사가 알아서 해주겠지 ? 우리는 현지 크리에이터와 직접 소통합니다.
• 해외 시장은 아마존 하나만 잘하면 되겠지? 우리는 다양한 채널을 공략합니다.
• 언어만 잘하면, 되겠지? 언어는 진입 조건이고 성과는 알고리즘, 규제 이해에서 납니다.

[ 이런 분께는 정말 잘 맞습니다 ]
• TikTok 추천 피드에 해외 숏폼이 이미 반 이상 뜨는 분
• Shopify, Amazon 등 앱을 켜두고 ‘이 브랜드는 왜 되지?’를 혼자 분석하는 분
• 한국 1등을 넘어, 해외 1등을 만들겠다는 승부욕이 있는 분

Benefits

＜ 기업문화 ＞
• 상호 존대를 통한 수평적 소통 문화(대표 포함)
• 회사는 명확한 방향성을 제시하고 직원은 자율적으로 업무
• 주도적, 능동적으로 일단 실행하는 도전적인 업무 문화
• 빠른 도전과 실패 그리고 피드백(애자일)을 장려하는 분위기
• 재직자 평균 28.5세로 젊은 문화와 분위기
• 연간 2회의 워크샵을 통한 방향성과 팀워크 강화

＜ 근무 방식 ＞
• 시차출퇴근제 운영 (9~10시 선택 출근, 8시간 근무)
• 완전 자율 복장
• 강제 회식 없음
• Notion, Slack 협업 툴을 활용한 업무 진행

＜ 구성원의 성장 지원 ＞
• 개인의 직무 성장을 위한 외부 교육 진행
• 직무 관련 세미나/워크샵 참여비 지원
• 직무 관련 도서 구입 지원
• 직무 교육비 100% 지원
• 사외 수강비 지원

＜ 보상 및 인센티브 ＞
• 성과에 따른 성과급 지급
• 진급 축하금 지급
• 근속상 지급

＜ 복지 및 혜택 ＞
• 평일·주말 구분 없이 365일 점심 식대 지원
• 저녁 식대 제공
• 매주 금요일 점심시간 90분
• 체력단련비 지원
• 생일 특별 반차, 축하 케이크 제공
• 리프레시 휴가비 지원
• 전직원 허먼밀러 의자 제공
• 사내 체력단련실&릴렉스룸 운영
• 팀 회식비 지원

＜ 선물 및 지원 ＞
• 매년 명절 선물 제공

Position Summary

Vertex is seeking an Agent Engineer, Agentic AI Platform to help create the next generation of AI agents that deliver practical value across internal and user-facing experiences. This role will focus on prototyping, building, and productionizing multi-step agent workflows that are deeply integrated with enterprise systems, business processes, and digital products.

The ideal candidate is energized by fast-moving AI technology but grounded in strong engineering discipline. This individual will use a forward deployed engineering mindset to work closely with stakeholders, rapidly iterate on real-world use cases, connect agents to APIs and business systems, and continuously improve quality through measurement and feedback. The Agent Engineer will play an important role in shaping how AI agents are adopted and used day to day across Vertex.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype, and productionize AI agents and multi-step agent workflows for internal and user-facing use cases
  • Apply a forward deployed engineering approach by working closely with end users, product teams, and business stakeholders to solve real workflow problems quickly and effectively

  • Help define best practices for agent design, tool use, fallback behavior, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of agents in production environments
  • Contribute to observability practices for agent execution, including logging, tracing, performance tracking, and issue analysis
  • Ensure solutions are designed with security, compliance, and responsible AI principles in mind
  • Stay current on emerging patterns, frameworks, and technologies in generative AI and agentic systems, and translate them into practical applications for Vertex

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered
  • Experience in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or intelligent application development

  • Experience working directly with users or stakeholders to iteratively refine technical solutions based on real-world needs
  • Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams

Technical Skills Required

  • Large language model application development
  • Agentic workflow design and orchestration
  • Prompt engineering and prompt iteration
  • Tool use and API integration for AI agents
  • Multi-step workflow automation
  • Rapid prototyping and productionization
  • Evaluation, testing, and quality measurement for AI systems
  • Application logging, monitoring, and observability
  • Distributed systems and service integration
  • Secure software development practices
  • Enterprise application integration
  • Cloud-based application development
  • Version control, CI/CD, and deployment practices

Preferred Skills

  • Experience using a forward deployed engineering or similar embedded delivery model
  • Experience building internal copilots, assistants, or task-oriented AI agents
  • Familiarity with orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, tool-calling architectures, and retrieval patterns
  • Experience integrating with enterprise collaboration tools, workflow systems, document platforms, or knowledge repositories
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for AI quality, groundedness, task completion, and reliability
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows and safe failure or escalation mechanisms
  • Exposure to AI observability, tracing, and operational analytics

title: Admissions Counselor
description:
The Admissions Counselor at High Point University serves as an integral member of the Office of Undergraduate Admissions team, responsible for managing and strategically developing an assigned geographic territory to support the University’s enrollment goals. This position plays a key role in identifying, recruiting, admitting, and enrolling academically qualified students who align with the mission and values of High Point University.

The Admissions Counselor will design and execute a comprehensive recruitment plan, actively representing the University at on- and off-campus events, high schools, college fairs, and other outreach initiatives. A successful candidate will maintain frequent and meaningful contact with prospective students, parents, and school counselors, demonstrating professionalism, empathy, and a deep understanding of students’ varied needs throughout the admissions process. This role requires excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, as well as a commitment to providing exceptional service and guidance to prospective students and their families.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required

Experience and Training:

  • Experience in admissions counseling, sales or customer service preferred

Knowledge, Skills, Ability:

  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of information
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office product and the Internet
  • Ability to travel extensively
  • Valid driver license with good driving record; must be insurable.

Essential Functions:

  • Creates Strategic Plan for attracting students with the right academic qualifications, from target high schools in assigned territory
  • Sets goals for assigned territory in regards to inquiries, applications, campus visitors, accepted students and enrolled students
  • Makes travel arrangements and manages travel schedule to visit target schools within travel budget
  • Travels 5-7 weeks in the fall and 2-3 weeks in the spring attending college fairs and private visits to targeted schools
  • Builds relationships with key high school guidance counselors and independent counselors in assigned territory; invites them to visit campus or attend a Counselor Open House at HPU
  • Manages evaluation of all completed files within assigned territory; makes initial admit/deny/waitlist decisions for prospective students
  • Meets with students and families after campus tours explaining application process, scholarship opportunities, study abroad, presidents seminar and answering all questions
  • Uses technical resources and predictive modeling to make informed decisions about student’s applications and outreach
  • Develops and maintains in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the University’s academic and extracurricular programs
  • Develops and maintains expertise to conduct campus tours; goes through tour shadowing program; conducts tours whenever needed
  • Handles assigned duties during Admissions Events during the year: Open Houses, Early Registrations, Presidential Scholarship Program, Spirit Event, etc.
  • Contributes to Admissions Team efforts by assisting other counselors as time permits
  • Maintains positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating effectively with students, students’ parents, faculty, co-workers and managers
  • Other duties as assigned

Accountability:

  • Contributes to the development and achievement of HPU’s recruitment objectives

For more information about this position. Please contact Tyshana Gardner, Associate Director of Admissions at tgardne1@highpoint.edu

title: Patient Services Representative
description:
Patient Services Representative-2
The Patient Access Representative (PAR) plays a crucial role in the hospital’s operational efficiency by ensuring a smooth admission, discharge, and transfer process for patients. The role requires strong communication skills, organizational abilities, and a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and safety. This position is integral to fostering a supportive and efficient environment in the facility, ensuring patients receive the care they need while upholding the standards of the healthcare facility. This position must also comply with all departmental, hospital, governmental, and other healthcare licensing agency regulations related to the Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act (EMTALA) and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
Qualifications required:
• High School Diploma or equivalent
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in a Patient Access Representative role within a Hospital, ER, or Clinic
• Previous experience in medical registration, admitting, and scheduling in an ER or hospital setting is preferred
Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities
1. Front Desk Operations:
• Greet all patients, guests, vendors in a professional, friendly, and courteous manner. Demonstrate and maintain knowledge of conducting business with customer service principles according to company standards, determining necessary services, and directing patients accordingly.
• Conduct accurate and complex patient registration and transactions as appropriate and in compliance with company protocols, facilitating efficient patient access with all hospital departments and billing.
• Maintain logs of patient information, maintain patient records by creating new files, scanning appropriate documentation to the EMR, filing, and discarding in accordance with federal and state regulations.
• Serves as first line resource for patient questions regarding insurance benefits and billing.
• Perform clerical duties such as faxing, copying, scanning; Answering, screening, and directing incoming phone calls, and maintaining office supplies.
• Conduct patient exit interviews to gather feedback, assist with obtaining patient satisfaction reviews, and proactively address and mitigate concerns prior to discharge to improve overall patient experience and retention.
2. Financial Responsibilities:
• Accurately collect applicable payments—based on insurance benefits and hospital self-pay rates—using cash, checks, or credit cards at the time of service and/or toward outstanding account balances.
• Enter patient payments into the computer software and provide receipts. Maintain an accurate financial ledger, balance and maintain cash drawer, and perform daily reconciliation of patient accounts.
3. Facility Cleanliness:
• Assist in maintaining the overall cleanliness of the facility.
4. Communication Skills:
• Interact courteously with patients, families, physicians, and team members, upholding the company’s core values
5. Professional Development:
• Attend monthly staff meetings and engage in performance improvement activities
6. Other Duties:
• Perform any job related to the registration and patient access process.
• Assist management with additional tasks or projects as assigned
Nonessential Job functions:
• Support patient care areas by ensuring appropriate supplies are stocked
• Assist with patient restraint procedures and documentation as needed
• Remain flexible with staffing patterns, and staffing conflicts that may include participating in temporary assignments.
Job Competencies:
• Proficient in navigating and utilizing Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
• Understanding and compliance with Hospital Policies and Procedures
• Commitment to ongoing education and professional development
Physical Requirements:
• Constant: Vision (various forms), Hearing, Speaking, Manual dexterity, Mobility
• Frequent: Bending, Squatting, Twisting, Lifting to 20 lbs. unaided, 50 lbs. with assistance
• Occasional: Climbing, Kneeling, Distinguishing colors
• Rarely: Exposure to electric shock and confined spaces
Work Environment:
• OSHA Category I: Routine exposure to blood, bodily fluids, or other potentially infectious material
• Adhere to and demonstrate knowledge of policies, procedures, and regulations pertaining to infection control, hazardous materials, fire safety, emergency preparedness, and safety.

title: Office of Career & Professional Development - Corporate Relations Graduate Assistant
description:
Job Title: Corporate Relations Graduate Assistant

Department: Office of Career & Professional Development

Supervisor: Marvina Hamilton/Assistant Director of Corporate Relations

Starting Rate of Pay: $12.00 per hour

Length of Employment: Eligible for rehire on a semester basis

Department Description:

The Office of Career & Professional Development supports students in their professional journey wherever they may be. Whether searching for the right major, planning a career, considering graduate school, developing a resume or prepping for a big interview, our office assists in this ongoing process. Through trustworthy career advising, innovative employer engagement events, and endless professional development opportunities – students have the chance to grow as a professional, so they are ready to enter the working world as it is going to be.

Job Summary:

The Office of Career and Professional Development - Corporate Relations team seeks a highly organized, detail-oriented Graduate Assistant (or Graduate Intern) to support employer relations initiatives, large-scale program planning and logistics (including HPU in the City, Career Investors, Life Skills Career Summit, etc.).

This role will provide project management support, assist with employer outreach and engagement, coordinate site visit logistics, and manage student participation data.

This is an excellent opportunity for a graduate student interested in higher education administration, career services, employer/corporate relations, student affairs, or program management.

Job Location & Hours:

The student employee will perform most or all job duties at: The Office of Career & Professional Development – Cottrell Hall. This position is fully in-office. No remote work is available. Business professional dress is required.

Work hours may vary depending on departmental needs; however, student employees are limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. This position is 15–20 hours per week (flexible scheduling between 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM).

Responsibilities:

Employer Relations & Partnership Support

  • Assist with employer outreach efforts (email communications, follow-ups, scheduling meetings).
  • Research and identify prospective employer partners aligned with student career pathways.
  • Maintain accurate employer records in the career services database.
  • Support coordination of employer site visits, panels, and networking events.
  • Draft professional correspondence and employer-facing materials as needed.

Program & Project Management (HPU in the City & Career Investors Support)

  • Assist in planning and executing logistics for multi-city employer site visits.
  • Track and organize employer confirmations, site visit details, and program schedules.
  • Maintain comprehensive student participation records (applications, placements, contact information, travel documentation, etc.).
  • Create tracking spreadsheets, timelines, and project plans to ensure milestones are met.
  • Support cross-functional communication between students, employers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare summary reports and program documentation as needed.

Student Career Development Support

  • Conduct resume and cover letter reviews and document feedback.
  • Support career-related workshops and events as needed.
  • Provide administrative and logistical support for career programming.

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Develop and maintain organized digital filing systems.
  • Assist with data entry and reporting.
  • Support office operations during peak programming periods.

Assist with other corporate relations initiatives as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a graduate program (Higher Education, Counseling, Business, Communications, Public Administration, or related field preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Desired Skills:

  • Interest in career services, employer relations, or program management.
  • Experience with event planning or project coordination.
  • Familiarity with career management systems (e.g., Handshake or similar platforms).
  • Prior experience supporting student development initiatives.

title: Senior Analyst, Commercial & Analytics
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the team:

We are seeking a Senior Analyst for our Commercial & Analytics team to drive strategic marketplace, pricing, and promotional decisions that optimize customer value.

This team manages marketplace strategy across all brands, focusing on revenue growth and balance. You will lead marketplace initiatives and promotional strategies, partnering across the organization to ensure successful execution through quantitative and strategic analysis.

This role reports into the Associate Director, Strategic Analytics and can be based out of any of our 4 office locations: Aix-en-Provence, Amsterdam, Berlin and London.

What you’ll do:

  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions.

  • Collaborate with broader marketing teams to develop and implement strategic initiatives that drive revenue/LTV growth and market expansion.

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive reports, dashboards, and visualizations to track key performance indicators (KPIs) that guide marketplace health.

  • Formulate A/B test frameworks to discern the impact of adjustments/new initiatives on marketplace & other business metrics.

  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance data accuracy, reporting efficiency, and overall analytical capabilities.

  • Leverage advanced analytical tools and AI tools to optimize workflows.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to ensure alignment of commercial strategies with overall business objectives.

  • Develop and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to senior leadership, accompanied by data-driven insights and rationale.

  • Stay informed about industry best practices, emerging pricing trends, and technological advancements to continuously improve marketplace growth.

Who you are:

  • 6+ years of professional experience as an analyst/senior analyst, preferably in a two-sided marketplace.

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business or a related field, with a strong analytical background.

  • Demonstrated capability to influence stakeholders and manage projects from strategy development through to successful execution.

  • Proficiency in data analysis & reporting tools (e.g.Tableau, Looker, and BigQuery/SQL, among others).

  • Comfortable utilizing AI tools to improve efficiencies and integrate their usage in daily work

  • Strong analytical skills and good at interpreting data, generating qualitative feedback and evaluating metrics to inform decision-making.

  • Good business acumen with a strong understanding of commercial topics.

  • Exceptional organizational skills, capable of managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in campaign management in a customer centric environment is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • The salary band for this position ranges from £68,000 - £90,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

  • Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance

  • Temporary work from abroad policy

  • Regular team and social events

title: Organisational Services Consultant - Organisational Psychologist
description:
GET TO KNOW ALTIUS
Altius was founded in 2001 with a simple aspiration; to drive new heights of workplace health and wellbeing. Since then, we've built a track record of expertise and positive impact in four critical service areas - PeopleSense Psychology & Wellbeing, Rehabilitation Services, Executive Health Solutions, and Workplace Health & Safety - that span the workplace wellbeing spectrum - still driven by a single goal: to elevate the wellbeing of people, workplaces and communities across Australia.

YOUR NEW ROLE
We're looking for a dynamic Organisational Services Consultant to join our Perth-based team.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives on variety, impact, and purpose working at the intersection of psychosocial risk, wellbeing, safety, and performance.

What You'll Do:
As part of our Organisational Services team, you'll deliver tailored, evidence-based solutions that support individuals, teams, and organisations to thrive. Your work will include:

  • Designing and delivering training workshops that build capability, performance, wellbeing and safety.
  • Leading psychosocial risk assessments to uncover insights and drive change.
  • Providing individual and group coaching to support growth, wellbeing and performance.
  • Administering and interpreting psychometric assessments and running assessment centres.
  • Facilitating conflict resolution, including mediations and team realignments.
  • Supporting career transitions with empathy and expertise.
  • Conducting onsite client engagements to deliver high-impact services.
  • Scoping and proposing organisational development projects that align with client goals.



ABOUT YOU

  • AHPRA Registered Psychologist
  • Masters in Industrial and Organisational Psychology OR Business Psychology
  • WA Driver's licence and own vehicle
  • Availability to travel (opportunities to travel to remote sites with access to competitive profit share bonus for overnight travel)
  • Endorsement in Organisational Psychology, or working towards (desirable)
  • Hogan or other psychometric assessment accreditation (desirable)
  • Mediation trained / accredited, or willing to obtain

WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US

  • Be warmly welcomed into your new team with a 3-month Induction Program
  • Enjoy the opportunity to provide bespoke and tailored solutions to customers
  • Take control of your career development and progression with tailored career pathways, supported by mentoring and peer supervision from experienced Organisational Psychologists and WHS Specialists
  • We prioritise professional development and offer annual allowances towards training based on individualised career goals
  • With business divisions across Australia, we offer opportunities to transfer your career across the Group and country. Our customers are also located across Australia, providing opportunities to travel to remote locations for on-site support.
  • Our remuneration packages comprise of competitive base salaries, performance-based salary reviews, and wellbeing benefits.
  • We are proud to acknowledge 76% of our promotions in the last year were to female members of our team.
  • Discover a workplace that values diversity, inclusion and equity, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds to bring their unique perspectives and talents to the table.


Our Wellbeing Promise

  • We offer flexible working arrangements so you can find a rhythm that works best for you! This includes flexible start & finish times, flexibility to work from home and from the office, school hour arrangements, and full-time & part-time work available.
  • Experience genuine support for your personal wellbeing including access to our AltiusLife wellness app, regular wellness seminars, and Employee Assistance Program.
  • We value leave! We offer our team members paid parental leave plus purchased leave arrangements to optimise your work-life balance.
  • Enjoy additional benefits - Fitness Passport, discounted health insurance, discounts to shops, etc.
  • You will receive the latest technology for efficient working, including a Surface Pro and smartphone.


HOW TO APPLY
If Altius sounds like a place to be you, click 'Apply Now'.
To learn more about the role, email Anna Caelli: ACaelli@altius-group.com.au, or call: 0411 121 775.

We are a Circle Back Initiative Employer - we commit to respond to every applicant.
Altius is an Equal Opportunity Employer and an inclusive workforce. Research has shown that, in Australia, women, people living with disability, LGBTQIA+, First Nations people, and those from minority groups are less likely to apply for a role because they feel they will not be successful. We believe in the strength of diversity and inclusion, and we would like to strongly encourage those who identify with any of these groups to apply for a role with us.

title: Solution Architect - RAN
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join our team at Ericsson as a Solution Architect, a critical role supporting end-to-end technical solutions for the RAN domain across Australia and New Zealand. Working within the Customer Support Team, which has a local strength of around 40 people across all domains, you will help ensure AMC deliverables are met for RAN customers across ANZA. This role is suited to a passionate technical leader who can resolve complex issues, provide expert consultation, shorten troubleshooting lead times, and support opportunities across Customer Support, pre-sales, domain delivery, service delivery and operations.


What you will do:
- Lead complex technical investigations across 5G and 4G RAN technologies, using protocol-level analysis and strong troubleshooting capability
- Provide network solutions on the latest technologies in Radio Access Network (RAN) space, considering E2E impacts
- Keep track of ongoing Customer service requests and ensure that concern is being addressed with the right priority
- Analyse and troubleshoot to handle and provide support in Critical and Emergency cases when needed
- Interface and interact with the relevant stakeholders and ensure the timely progress on Customer service requests for Critical/ Priority cases
- Handle customer technical queries all the time and ensure timely response
- Take handover from Projects and ensure all the check points are completed
- Organize and deliver knowledge sharing sessions with stakeholders
- Review and prepare relevant technical documents i.e. RCA
- Proven ability to technically analyse and approve solution implementation for the customer
- Exceptional troubleshooting skills required to solve customer issues
- Lead Optimization discussions/issues/Investigations and work closely with product experts to address customer escalations/requirements
- Drive prioritized improvement initiatives in key strategic and operational areas
- Solid grasp and experience in RF design and tuning in 4G/5G RAN product and network
- Participate in deliver services around the SWUS programs like – Feature massification, KPI analysis and agreement with stakeholders.

You will bring:
- Domain Expertise: Radio Access Network (RAN) -4G/5G
- Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent
- Min 15 years of experience, most recent 5 years’ experience must be in 5G/LTE
- Hands on experience on Ericsson RAN product is must
- Strong technical acumen exhibited when dealing with complex customer issues.
- Strong configuration knowledge of various RAN Solution in MSRBS/DSS/CA
- Ability to perform tracing and complex logs analysis for RAN Nodes
- Must have call flows, protocols, 3GPP and Interface related knowledge in 5G RAN
- Ability to technically analyse and approve solution implementation for customers
- Exceptional troubleshooting skills to solve customer issues without escalating to the next level
- Transport and Core network basic troubleshooting
- Previous experience working in telecommunications support/care/Level2/R&D/Integration

title: SAP Super User (50% Travel)
description:
The SAP Super User will be an integral part of the Implementation Team, responsible for managing testing end-to-end, participating in developing and implementing effective operating processes and systems for new business initiatives. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with a strong understanding of SAP functionalities, training development, and testing methodologies. The ideal candidate will possess excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with diverse teams.

YOUR TASKS

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement operating processes and systems for new business initiatives.
  • Create project-specific training concepts and execute training programs to ensure end-users are proficient in system functionalities and processes. Ensure all training is thoroughly documented.
  • Develop testing matrices, ensuring the testing process involves the right resources and aligns with project goals. Oversee the execution of testing phases.
  • End-to-End Testing: Conduct thorough testing of all processes from Front-End to Back-End, including assisting in system unit testing, integration testing, and regression testing to validate system performance and functionality.
  • Identify and troubleshoot system-related issues, working closely with various IT teams to resolve problems efficiently.
  • Create and update training materials for new functionalities and system updates, ensuring they are accessible and user-friendly.
  • Utilize data analysis tools to extract insights and support the SAP team in optimizing system performance and user experience.
  • Actively participate in departmental process improvements, providing support and recommendations based on system performance and user feedback.

YOUR PROFILE

  • High School Diploma or equivalent; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Knowledge of SAP pertaining to warehouse activities.
  • Distribution Center or Manufacturing experience.
  • Strong technology skills.
  • Flexibility is a must: Must be able to work overtime, holidays, weekends, different shifts, and different areas of the warehouse.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, occasionally more as needed.

WE OFFER

  • Monthly return flight home for assignments that are 4+ weeks.
  • Project completion bonus.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Disability Pay.
  • 401(k) with company matching up to 6%.
  • Paid Time Off, including paid holidays, plus an additional 5 vacation days with option for payout.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts.
  • Voluntary benefits such as legal and financial assistance, pet insurance, and more.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Ongoing employee development opportunities including tuition reimbursement, scholarships, and training.
  • Commuter benefits.
  • Employee engagement activities.

Workday HCM Administrator

The Workday HCM Administrator (Admin level) supports the day-to-day administration, configuration, security, and ongoing optimization of the Workday platform across core HCM and the following modules: Payroll, Benefits, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Advanced Compensation, Talent Optimization, Messaging, and Peakon. This role partners with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, Accounting and IT stakeholders to maintain data integrity, resolve user and process issues, support releases, and deliver system enhancements aligned to HR operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and configure Workday HCM and module functionality (Payroll, Benefits, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Advanced Compensation, Talent Optimization, Messaging, Peakon), including business processes, condition rules, validations, notifications, and tenant settings.
  • Maintain Workday security (roles, domains, business process security policies, user-based security) and support user provisioning, access troubleshooting, and periodic audits/access reviews.
  • Support Payroll and Time Tracking operations by troubleshooting pay-impacting issues, coordinating retro/corrections workflows, and partnering with Payroll to validate configuration changes through testing.
  • Support Benefits administration activities (enrollments, life events, eligibility, provider feeds troubleshooting in partnership with integration teams/vendors) and help ensure data accuracy between Workday and vendors.
  • Support Recruiting processes and configuration, including job requisition workflows, candidate and offer processes, security/access, and reporting; troubleshoot end-user issues.
  • Administer Advanced Compensation and Talent Optimization configuration and annual cycle support (eligibility, guidelines, worksheets, reviews, and analytics/reporting) in partnership with HR/Comp leaders.
  • Support Employee/Manager communications through Workday Messaging and partner with HR stakeholders to configure, test, and publish messaging campaigns where applicable.
  • Support Peakon administration (user access, org structure alignment, data loads where applicable, and reporting) and coordinate with HR leaders on survey cadence changes and issue triage.
  • Develop and maintain Workday reporting and dashboards (custom reports, calculated fields, and report sharing/security) to meet HR and business needs.
  • Execute data loads and mass updates using EIB/imports; perform data validation and reconciliations to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Support Workday releases by reviewing release impacts, coordinating regression/UAT testing with stakeholders, updating configuration as needed, and communicating changes.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot tenant issues (business process exceptions, security access problems, data discrepancies, integration-related errors) and escalate/coordinate with Workday, vendors, or internal teams as needed.
  • Document configurations, procedures, test scripts, and change controls; maintain system runbooks and knowledge articles.
  • Provide Tier 2 support to HR Operations/HRIS, including ticket intake, root-cause analysis, and end-user guidance and training on Workday best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years of Workday administration/HRIS experience with hands-on configuration and production support.
  • Experience supporting multiple Workday functional areas such as Payroll, Benefits, Time Tracking, Recruiting, or Compensation.
  • Working knowledge of Workday business processes, security concepts, and the Workday data model.
  • Experience building or maintaining reports (custom reports and calculated fields) and using data to troubleshoot issues.
  • Experience performing data loads/mass updates using EIB (and/or similar Workday load tools) with attention to data quality.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday training and/or certification (e.g., Workday Pro) in HCM, Security, Reporting, Payroll, Benefits, Time Tracking, Recruiting, or Compensation.
  • Experience supporting Advanced Compensation cycles and/or Talent Optimization processes (performance, goals, talent reviews) in Workday.
  • Experience supporting Workday Messaging and/or Peakon administration (including stakeholder communications and reporting).
  • Experience partnering with integration resources on vendor/provider feeds and inbound/outbound interfaces; familiarity with Core Connectors, Studio, or file-based integrations (SFTP, CSV/XML).
  • Experience supporting audits, access reviews, and controls related to HR/payroll data privacy and compliance (e.g., SOX concepts where applicable).
  • Experience with Agile delivery methods and change management (documentation, communications, training, and UAT).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle (hire-to-retire).
  • Ability to diagnose issues using data, logs, reports, and business process analysis; propose options with risks/impacts.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality, security, and user experience.
  • Strong documentation skills (processes, configuration, test scripts, release notes, and knowledge articles).
  • Professional communication skills and ability to influence without authority.

title: Customer Services Team Lead

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Senior Specialist, Program Scheduler (Remote)

Job Code: 41973

Job Location: Remote Opportunity

Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

Job Description:

L3Harris is seeking a Program Scheduler to join their team. Duties include managing the development and maintenance of complex program schedules including resource loading and Earned Value Analysis. This position also supports the programs in developing plans and integrating inputs from all programs. Qualified candidates will interface with all elements of the program team to develop and support regular maintenance of the program IMS. This individual will perform schedule analysis in support of assigned programs and projects. Ensure major projects and program schedules and plans are integrated across company functional groups including finance, engineering, material, manufacturing, and quality. Track plans and schedules, perform risk analysis, identify and resolve critical path and network logic conflicts. Utilize Critical path, Driving Path, Variance metrics, milestone charts, Earned Value Management and other project management techniques to gauge progress and identify performance variances to facilitate focus and intervention on critical areas. Ensure compliance with internal program procedures and project control system guidelines per DECM metrics.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop integrated master schedules (IMS) using SOW, and WBS.
  • Manage complex projects or processes with general oversight.
  • Create and track plans and schedules, perform risk analysis, and identify and resolve critical path and network logic conflicts.
  • Analysis and validation of program schedules through baseline maintenance including support Critical Path Analysis, Schedule Risk Analysis, and Schedule Metric Analysis such as BEI, CEI, CPLI, SPI, etc.
  • Implement and monitor Earned Value Management Systems on programs.
  • Communicate within and outside of own function to gain cooperation on operational processes, practices, and procedures and have responsibility for communicating with parties external to the organization (e.g., customers, vendors, etc.) when necessary.
  • Ensure projects and program schedules and plans are integrated across company functional groups including finance, engineering, material, manufacturing, and quality.
  • Ensure compliance with internal program procedures and project control system guidelines.
  • Explain, interpret, and gain cooperation on policies, procedures, and practices related to program scheduling.
  • Attend and lead scheduling status reviews and conduct briefings with senior leaders which requires ability to communicate matters of importance to the function or business area.
  • Contribute to achievement of departmental goals and operating plans with direct impact on the departmental results.
  • Participate in schedule training, engineering, and program excellence organization.
  • Up to 20% business travel to other L3Harris sites.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and minimum 6 years of prior scheduling experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years prior scheduling experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related scheduling experience.
  • 3+ Years experience creating and/or maintaining an Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and any Supporting Schedules on assigned projects/programs.
  • 3+ Years experience utilizing scheduling software, i.e. Microsoft Project.
  • 2+ Years experience creating and presenting project-level reports, presentations, and deliverables that reflect risk and status to program management and senior management relating to the IMS.

Preferred Additional Skills:

  • Working knowledge of Planning & Scheduling Excellence Guide (PASEG), Latest Version, EVMS Standard (EIA 748-D), Integrated Product and Process Development (IPPD), and Integrated Program Management Report (IPMR) strongly desired.
  • Monte Carlo Risk Analysis (Schedule Risk Analysis).
  • Agile Development methodologies associated with EVMS.
  • Critical thinking and problem solving.
  • Attention to detail and quality of product deliverables.
  • Familiarity with scheduling ad-on tools such as OPDEC, Structured Solutions - SSI tools management, RiskyProject or similar scheduling support software.
  • Experience with cost and schedule integration software.
  • Experience in macro development.
  • Ability to work with a team and on their own.

잉클(Ingkle)은 2019년에 설립되었고, 산업 설비 데이터를 빠르게 수집하고 저장·분석할 수 있는 온프레미스형 AI 데이터 플랫폼 ‘Nazare(나자레)’를 자체 개발한 기술 스타트업입니다. 사업은 충청남도 천안 본사 중심으로 진행되고, 기술은 경기도 수원 연구소에서 만들고 있습니다. 국내 30개 이상의 제조업체를 고객사로 두고 있고, 국가R&D 과제와 공공사업을 다수 수행 중입니다. 지금까지 35억원을 투자받았고, 천안시의 미래유니콘 기업으로 지정되어 있습니다. 구성원의 80% 이상은 소프트웨어 개발자입니다.
