title: Clinical Credentialing and Compliance Specialist
description:
High Point University is seeking a Clinical Credentialing and Compliance Specialist who is responsible for managing the credentialing, recredentialing, and ongoing compliance activities for licensed clinical providers primarily within dental services and emerging optometry clinical operations, including medical billing and payer requirements associated with dental procedures billed under medical insurance. This role ensures that all providers meet federal, state, accreditation, payer, and organizational requirements prior to appointment and throughout the duration of their service. The Specialist serves as a key liaison between providers, licensing boards, payers, and internal departments to maintain accurate, timely, and compliant credentialing records.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Associate’s degree required; bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business management, or a related field preferred.
  • Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or Certified Professional Medical Services Management (CPMSM) preferred.
  • Experience in an academic dental or optometry clinic setting, FQHC, or multi-specialty practice preferred.
  • Familiarity with Joint Commission, NCQA, HRSA, CMS, and state-specific regulatory requirements.

Experience and Training

  • Minimum of 2 years of healthcare credentialing experience with emphasis on dental providers and services, including medical and optometry credentialing as applicable.
  • CAQH enrollment and maintenance knowledge.
  • Medicare enrollment and revalidation knowledge required.
  • Knowledge of NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and state licensing requirements.

Knowledge, Skills, Ability

  • In-depth knowledge of dental and optometry regulatory requirements, licensure standards, and compliance obligations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized.
  • Proficiency in credentialing software and compliance tools.
  • Professional certifications in healthcare credentialing, compliance, or dental practice management are a plus.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Credentialing and Enrollment Management

  • Coordinate initial credentialing and recredentialing for dental, and optometry providers, including dentists, optometrists, and other licensed clinical personnel, including medical payer enrollment related to dental services as applicable.
  • Verify education, training, licensure, board certification, DEA registration, clinical privileges, work history, and professional references in accordance with organizational policy and regulatory standards.
  • Prepare and maintain credentialing files, ensuring all documentation is complete, accurate, and current.
  • Track expirations and proactively manage renewals for licenses, certifications, malpractice insurance, and other required credentials.
  • Prepare credentialing files for review by credentialing committees, clinical leadership, or governing bodies.
  • Develop and implement efficient enrollment procedures for new dental and optometry providers, optimizing the onboarding process and minimizing time-to-productivity.

Compliance and Regulatory Oversight

  • Ensure credentialing processes comply with applicable regulations and standards, including but not limited to CMS, Joint Commission, NCQA, HRSA, state licensing boards, and payer requirements.
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with dental and optometry regulatory requirements, including state and federal laws and payer standards.
  • Assist with audits, site visits, and surveys by accrediting bodies and regulatory agencies; compile and present requested documentation.
  • Identify compliance gaps or credentialing risks and escalate concerns to leadership as appropriate.

Data Management and Reporting

  • Maintain credentialing data within credentialing management systems, HRIS, or other databases.
  • Generate reports related to credentialing status, expirations, compliance metrics, and audit readiness.
  • Ensure confidentiality and security of all credentialing and provider information.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as primary point of contact for providers regarding credentialing, recredentialing, and compliance questions.
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, Billing, and Clinical Leadership to support provider onboarding and ongoing compliance.
  • Provide guidance and education to providers related to credentialing and timelines.

ACCOUNTABILITY

Reports to the Manager of Clinical Revenue Operations Cycle. Performance is evaluated based on credentialing accuracy, compliance outcomes, onboarding timeliness, and audit readiness.

For more information regarding this position, please contact Jennifer Hicks, Manager of Clinical Revenue Operations Cycle at jhicks4@highpoint.edu.

title: ENT NP/PA | No Call | Academic Practice | Washington, DC
description:
Opportunity Details

Practice ENT in one of Washington, DC’s premier academic medical groups. Capital Medical Group (CMG), formerly known as GW Medical Faculty Associates, is seeking an experienced Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Associate/Physician Assistant (PA) to join our established Otolaryngology (ENT) practice in Washington, DC.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced ENT NP/PA or NP/PA from Surgery, Family Medicine, or Urgent Care who is interested in expanding their clinical expertise in Ear, Nose, & Throat (ENT) medicine. Work alongside nationally recognized physicians in a collaborative academic environment while enjoying a predictable Monday-Friday schedule, no call responsibilities, and a practice environment designed to support long-term career satisfaction.

Position Overview

  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Schedule / Hours: Monday – Friday, 8 am to 5 pm; (9 clinical sessions and 1 administrative session per week)
  • Call: None
  • Patient Volume: Approximately 15-18 (varies)
  • Location: Capital Medical Group; Washington, DC
  • Practice Setting: ENT Outpatient Clinic
  • Support / Care Team: Practice includes 9 ENT physicians, 3 Audiologists, 1 Speech Language Pathologist, and dedicated MA support
  • EMR / Technology: Epic

Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive, outpatient ENT care for a diverse, adult patient population, ranging from routine otolaryngology concerns to complex specialty conditions.
  • Collaborate with physicians and APPs to coordinate patient care across multiple ENT subspecialties, including rhinology, laryngology/voice disorders, sleep medicine, thyroid and skull base surgery.
  • Practice at the top of your license with a high degree of clinical autonomy and access to physician support when needed.
  • Document clinical encounters using Epic EMR.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $125K-$145K range; based on experience and scope of practice
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Retirement Plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • CME Allowance and Licensure Support

Required Qualifications

  • Board Certified or Board Eligible NP/PA
  • Active or eligible Washington, DC medical license
  • Minimum of one year of experience (following training) – new graduates will not be accepted for this opportunity

Growth & Development

  • Dedicated APP mentor
  • Structured Orientation Program
  • Extended Clinical Training and ENT Education
  • Collaborative Physician Support

About the Organization & Community

Capital Medical Group

Providers with Capital Medical Group deliver high-quality primary care, health screenings and advanced specialized care to adults of the DMV (the District, Maryland, and Virginia). At Capital Medical Group, our specially trained and highly experienced physicians and caregivers treat a wide range of conditions using advanced technologies and minimally invasive techniques. Formerly known as Medical Faculty Associates, we offer wellness services, geriatric services, women’s services, and internal medicine, along with specialty care including gastroenterology, a full suite of surgical services, orthopedic services, cardiology, pulmonary medicine, ophthalmology, and more through a network of nearly 20 hospital and care locations, including GW University Hospital, Cedar Hill Regional Medical Center, and GW Urgent Care, as well as affiliated sites. We are proud to deliver equitable care to neighbors and communities across the region. Our academic affiliation is with the George Washington University School of Medicine and Health Sciences.

Living in Washington, DC

Washington, DC is known as the seat of American democracy, often recognized for its iconic monuments, world-class museums, and rich political history. It is well known for the National Mall and its historic landmarks, but there is so much more to life in the DMV. The region also has renowned theaters and performance venues, professional sports teams, award-winning dining options, and gorgeous parks and recreation areas nestled in and adjacent to the city, where residents can enjoy the outdoors. And, being an area with three major airports, coupled with its location that is just a few hours from the beaches of Maryland and Delaware, the Shenandoah Mountains or New York City, all types of experiences are within reach. From the charming neighborhoods of Georgetown and Capitol Hill, to the vibrant and thriving communities in the suburbs of Maryland and Northern Virginia, there are many wonderful communities of people and families who call the DMV home. These communities are served by world-class educational institutions, including some of the nation’s leading public and private schools and universities. Simply put, the DMV is a place where history, opportunity, and community converge to make it one of the most dynamic and desirable places to live in the nation.

title: Registered Psychologist
description:

PeopleSense by Altius, a subsidiary of Altius, has been providing psychological services since 1998. title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer 3 (Clinical / Pharmacy)
description:
Job Description

UW MEDICINE IT SERVICES has an outstanding job opportunity for a Senior Business Intelligence Developer 3 (Clinical / Pharmacy) position.

WORK SCHEDULE

  • 100% FTE – 40 hours per week
  • Day Shift – UW MEDICINE ITS SERVICES CORE HOURS ARE 08:00 – 17:00 (PST), Monday-Friday

DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION

UW Medicine IT Services (ITS) is a shared services organization that supports all of UW Medicine. UW Medicine is comprised of Harborview Medical Center (HMC), UW Medical Center-Montlake Campus (UWMC-Montlake), UW Medical Center-Northwest Campus (UWMC-NW), Valley Medical Center (VMC), UW Medicine Primary Care (UWMPC), UW Physicians (UWP), UW School of Medicine (SOM), and Airlift Northwest (ALNW). ITS is responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the infrastructure and applications which support all these institutions, along with the implementation of new services and applications that are used to support and further the UW Medicine mission.

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS

  • 100% remote opportunity
  • 15 days of vacation your first year – Also, 12 days of sick time, 1 personal holiday, and 11 paid holidays each year
  • 100% matching, 100% immediately vesting 403(b)

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify business and technical impacts of user requirements and articulate to all constituents
  • Assume responsibility for the quality and delivery of technology business solutions
  • Create ad hoc queries, data sources, and reports to support the operations
  • Collaborate with Analytics leadership to help set direction, standards, and process for a team of BI Developers
  • Work with other BI Developers, Cogito Developers, Analytics Business Analysts, Clinical Informatics, application teams, and operational and clinical customers to gather, analyze, and document reporting requirements
  • Utilize Epic’s Cogito suite of tools to deliver data solutions
  • Design, code, test, and maintain reporting and analytics objects, including extracts, utilizing industry best practices
  • Provide production support and respond to Help Desk tickets related to the BI development tool set and Epic Cogito suite
  • Mentor and provide guidance, direction, and support to other developers

The Analytics Group has a dual report into both ITS and UW School of Medicine and provides operational oversight for the major analytics platforms and tools at UW Medicine. Analytics is a key support function as UW Medicine transitions towards value-based health care. The Epic Cogito reporting team provides analytic solutions across UW Medicine, specifically for finance, operations, institutional quality improvement, research, and clinical analytics. This position is focused to the Epic Clinical domain and works closely with UW Medicine ITS customers and a team of developers to provide analysis, recommend appropriate solutions, and develop those solutions using the best BI solutions available.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Information Systems, Math, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field or equivalent combination of education/experience
  • Epic certification in Clinical Data Model
  • Epic certifications in Epic Cogito Fundamentals, Caboodle Data Model Fundamentals, Clarity Data Model, and Cogito Tools Administration
  • Strong, applied experience with Epic Willow reporting
  • Strong, applied experience with Epic Clarity and Caboodle Data Models and Reporting for medium to large scale projects
  • Strong, applied experience with Epic Cogito tools (SlicerDicer, SQL Metrics, Reporting Workbench, Radar Dashboards, Cogito SQL)
  • 4 years of experience must include the following:
    • 4+ years of recent healthcare or IT experience
    • 3+ years of experience with BI reporting tools
    • 3+ years of experience with SQL, writing complex, highly optimized, queries across large volumes of data, database design, data warehouse design, query performance tuning, and writing stored procedures

UW MEDICINE – WHERE YOUR IMPACT GOES FURTHER

UW Medicine is Washington’s only health system that includes a top-rated medical school and an internationally recognized research center. UW Medicine’s mission is to improve the health of the public by advancing medical knowledge, providing outstanding primary and specialty care to the people of the region, and preparing tomorrow’s physicians, scientists and other health professionals.

All across UW Medicine, our employees collaborate to perform the highest quality work with integrity and compassion and to create a respectful, welcoming environment where every patient, family, student and colleague is valued and honored. Nearly 29,000 healthcare professionals, researchers, and educators work in the UW Medicine family of organizations that includes: Harborview Medical Center, UW Medical Center - Montlake, UW Medical Center - Northwest, Valley Medical Center, UW Medicine Primary Care, UW Physicians, UW School of Medicine, and Airlift Northwest.

Become part of our team. Join our mission to make life healthier for everyone in our community.

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team


Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.

#LI-PRIO

About the role

Join us as a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to spearhead the technical direction and delivery of complex, innovative AI projects. You will act as a technical expert, applying your skills across various projects from AI strategy to client-side deployments, while ensuring architectural decisions are sound and reliable.

This role demands a balance of deep technical expertise and strong leadership, focusing on driving innovation, fostering team growth, and building reusable solutions across the organisation. If you're ready to manage high-risk projects and deliver practical, innovative outcomes, this is your chance to shape our future.

What you'll be doing

  • Setting the technical direction for complex ML projects, balancing trade-offs, and guiding team priorities.

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML/software systems and justifying key architectural decisions.

  • Defining project problems, developing roadmaps, and overseeing delivery across multiple workstreams in often ill-defined, high-risk environments.

  • Driving the development of shared resources and libraries across the organisation and guiding other engineers in contributing to them.

  • Leading hiring processes, making informed selection decisions, and mentoring multiple individuals to foster team growth.

  • Proactively developing and executing recommendations for adopting new technologies and changing our ways of working to stay ahead of the competition.

  • Acting as a technical expert and coach for customers, accurately estimating large work-streams and defending rationale to stakeholders.

Who we're looking for

  • You are a technical expert among your peers, capable of going deep on particular topics and demonstrating breadth of knowledge to solve almost any problem.

  • You possess strong Python skills and practical experience operationalising models using frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

  • You are an expert in at least one major Cloud Solution Provider (e.g., Azure, GCP, AWS) and have led teams to build full-stack web applications.

  • You have hands-on experience with containerisation tools like Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes.

  • You can successfully manage and coach a team of engineers, setting team-wide development goals to improve client delivery.

  • You find novel, clever solutions for project delivery and take ownership for successful project outcomes.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can proactively help customers achieve their goals and guide both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Our Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the role (45 minutes)

  3. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  4. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

description:

Preferred Qualifications

title: Electrical Engineering Coordinator
description:
Advancing careers. Advancing everyday life.

Glencore is committed to providing an environment that adheres to the Respect at Work Legislation.

Oaky Creek Coal, a Glencore Managed Operation, produces high quality export coking coal. We are a large, dynamic mine with a proven track record. We’re professional, take personal ownership and we’re committed to providing exceptional outcomes all while delivering safe coal. At Oaky we know it’s our people that make it all possible. Our culture promotes flexibility and team work and rewards dedicated people with a can-do spirit, who take responsibility, and who have the drive to be leaders in their field. We expect a lot, but we give a lot in return. We recognise and reward exceptional work.

Oaky Creek Coal is seeking an experienced and motivated Electrical Engineering Coordinator to join our Engineering and Maintenance team.

Reporting to the Technology Superintendent, this role is responsible for coordinating, managing and overseeing electrical, automation and process control maintenance activities across a wide range of underground and surface assets that support our mining operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in improving electrical equipment reliability and advancing automation technology at one of Australia's leading low-seam underground coal mining operations.

About the Role

As the Electrical Engineering Coordinator, you will lead a team of Process Control and Automation Engineers whilst also providing technical leadership across electrical, control, and automation systems.

You will also be responsible for ensuring that the safety, performance, and reliability of critical electrical infrastructure and operational systems are maintained to the highest level across the site. Partnering with site operational teams, OEMs, and key internal/external stakeholders, the role leads and supports commissioning and asset handover activities, champions continuous improvement opportunities, and delivers specialist technical support for planned and emergent maintenance events across electrical, process control, and automation systems.

A key focus here will be on enhancing electrical equipment reliability, minimising downtime, reducing Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) times, and optimising asset performance through effective troubleshooting and root cause analysis leading to quality actions to prevent reoccurrence.

You will also be involved with technology-driven improvements in safety, reliability, productivity, and operational performance, prioritising simple, scalable, and cost-effective solutions that achieve the greatest return with minimal investment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate strong safety leadership and promote a positive safety culture
  • Lead and support a team of Process Control and Automation Engineers to monitor asset performance and resolve technical issues as they arise
  • Support the commissioning and asset handover process of new and existing electrical, process control and automation systems
  • Be across and directly involved in the planning, execution and review of all site electrical engineering, process control and automation maintenance activities (both planned and unplanned events)
  • Review electrical/process/automation equipment performance and delay data on a regular basis to ensure issues are identified and actioned to prevent reoccurrence in a timely manner
  • Work collaboratively with OEMs and external contractors develop innovative but cost-effective solutions to operational problems
  • Work with the site Electrical Engineering Manager (EEM) and Electrical Engineers to ensure asset compliance with relevant legislation, standards and company requirements

About You

To be successful in this role, you will be a hands-on leader with strong technical capability and a passion for developing people and improving operational performance.

You will also require:

  • Tertiary qualifications in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with at least 3 years’ experience in a role that requires the active use of this qualification
  • Strong knowledge of electrical engineering systems, process control systems, network communications and industrial software applications
  • A sound understanding of Longwall and Development mining processes with production experience in either discipline highly regarded
  • A sound understanding of risk management, safe work practices and relevant Australian Standards
  • A strong working knowledge of Queensland coal mining legislation, statutory requirements, and compliance standards, with practical experience in an EEM or EEM Delegate capacity considered advantageous.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder engagement abilities
  • High levels of organisation, initiative, resourcefulness and attention to detail
  • Experience in a similar role within an underground coal mining environment will be highly regarded

What We Offer

At Oaky Creek Coal, we recognise and reward our people with a competitive remuneration package and a supportive working environment.

Benefits include:

  • Highly competitive mining industry salary
  • Annual short-term performance bonus
  • Five weeks annual leave
  • Coal Mining Industry Long Service Leave benefits
  • Salary sacrifice opportunities.
  • Education Assistance to support further study and professional development
  • Relocation assistance for successful candidates
  • Generous subsidised housing in Tieri, Queensland
  • A family-friendly community with excellent facilities and lifestyle opportunities

title: Ultrasound Technologist
description:
Ultrasound Technologist

The Ultrasound Technologist plays a critical role in patient care by performing ultrasonic diagnostic procedures as prescribed by physicians. This position requires a commitment to patient comfort and safety, and maintaining high-quality and compliance standards in imaging practices.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Diagnostic Procedures: Perform ultrasound/sonography procedures on patients, including preparing them for exams, positioning them appropriately, selecting the correct imaging techniques, and ensuring image quality.
  • Data Management: Enter and accurately monitor patient data within the electronic medical record system.
  • Equipment Quality Assurance: Conduct regular quality-assurance checks on ultrasound equipment to ensure proper functionality and safety.
  • Incident Reporting: Promptly identify and report any accidents, complaints, or equipment malfunctions to departmental management.
  • Patient and Staff Safety: Always ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.
  • Additional Duties: Perform tasks or responsibilities assigned by the immediate supervisor or department director.
  • Meetings: Attend staff and company-sponsored meetings as required to stay informed and involved.

Job Competencies:

  • Electronic Medical Records Navigation: Proficient in navigating and utilizing electronic medical records systems.
  • Policy Compliance: Understand and comply with hospital policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Professional Development: Maintain and enhance skill levels through ongoing education, collaborative training with colleagues and physicians, and annual skills checkoffs.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Exhibit mindfulness, compassion, and excellent people skills to foster a supportive patient environment.

Qualifications Required:

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as an Ultrasound Technologist/Sonographer.
  • Certifications: ARDMS certification and BLS (Basic Life Support) certification.
  • Prior experience in a hospital setting is preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Constant: Ability to maintain vision (close, distance, color, peripheral, depth, and adjust focus); hear, speak, and use hands for detailed tasks; walk, sit, maintain balance, perform repetitive motions, and utilize arm, leg, and back muscles for extended periods.
  • Frequent: Ability to bend, squat, twist, push/pull up to twenty pounds without assistance; up to fifty pounds with assistance; lift/carry up to twenty pounds without assistance; up to fifty pounds with assistance.
  • Occasional: Climb, kneel, crouch; distinguish colors; be exposed to noise/high-pitched sounds; hazards, allergens, toxins/chemicals/detergents/radiation.
  • Rarely: Potential exposure to electric shock; work in confined spaces.
  • Other: Must wear personal protective equipment, including gloves, gowns, goggles, and masks.
  • Potential Exposure: May encounter infectious diseases and risks associated with cuts and bruises.

Work Environment:

  • OSHA Category I: Normal work routine involves exposure to blood, bodily fluids, or tissues as part of employment responsibilities.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Agentic AI Platform, BYO Capability

Vertex is seeking a Sr. Principal AI Engineer, Agentic AI Platform to design, build, and optimize the shared platform capabilities that power AI-enabled products and intelligent workflows across the enterprise. This role will focus on delivering production-grade platform services for model integration, prompt and workflow orchestration, evaluation, observability, performance optimization, and agent lifecycle management.

A key focus of this role will be enabling a build/bring-your-own-agents capability within the Agentic AI Platform, allowing teams across Vertex to create, integrate, customize, and operationalize their own agents using shared platform standards, tooling, and governance controls.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep experience in applied AI systems. This individual will be comfortable operating across rapid experimentation and engineering rigor, translating emerging AI capabilities into scalable, reliable, secure, and reusable platform components. The Senior Principal AI Engineer will play a critical leadership role in accelerating AI adoption across Vertex by enabling product teams to build and deploy AI solutions faster and more effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop shared AI/agentic platform services that support enterprise AI products and internal workflows
  • Design and implement a build/bring-your-own-agents capability that enables teams to create, register, integrate, deploy, and manage their own agents within the enterprise agentic platform
  • Establish reusable frameworks, SDKs, templates, interfaces, and guardrails that standardize how custom agents are built and onboarded onto the platform
  • Define agent lifecycle capabilities including agent registration, configuration, testing, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retirement
  • Build and maintain robust integrations with foundation models, model gateways, APIs, enterprise tools, and related AI infrastructure
  • Design and implement systems for prompt orchestration, workflow execution, tool use, memory patterns, and agentic task coordination
  • Develop reusable frameworks and services for evaluation, benchmarking, and validation of AI model, agent, and workflow performance
  • Establish platform capabilities for observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, and alerting across AI workloads and autonomous agent interactions
  • Optimize platform performance, scalability, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency for production AI and agentic systems
  • Partner with product, data, engineering, security, and architecture teams to enable enterprise-ready AI solutions
  • Translate prototypes and experimental concepts into hardened, maintainable, production-grade services
  • Define engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns for AI platform development and deployment
  • Support governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices through measurable controls, policy enforcement, and technical safeguards for agent behavior
  • Drive platform adoption by creating reusable components, documentation, onboarding patterns, and developer enablement resources
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI platform initiatives
  • Evaluate emerging tools, frameworks, and architectural patterns in generative AI and agentic systems to inform platform strategy

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred
  • Significant industry experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI platform development, including experience in senior or principal-level technical roles

title: Chapel and Religious Life - Outreach Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Chapel Outreach Coordinator

Department: Chapel and Religious Life

Supervisor: Preston Davis

Starting Rate of Pay: 10.00

Length of Time: Eligible for rehire on a semester basis

Department Description

Our Mission: the overriding ambition of Hayworth Chapel and the Religious Life Office (aka “The Chapel”) of High Point University® is to build a BELOVED community on the campus of High Point University by helping students:

  • Experience and practice BELONGING.
  • BECOME who they are called to be.
  • BEHOLD the presence of God’s grace in all that they do.

The Chapel, fostered by its Christian tradition, exists to deepen High Point University’s Christian character and practice, which also means being a place of radical hospitality to people of all traditions. In this way, HPU is committed to it's Christian tradition and interfaith belonging, modeling inter-religious understanding and cooperation.

Job Description

The Chapel Outreach Coordinator assists the Chapel and Religious Life Office by increasing the connection between weekly Chapel (and/or HPU Sunday) and the HPU Community. Coordinators are charged with building relationships with interested students, enhancing the connection of the weekly Chapel community, and broadening its social networks. Serving as a resource to meaningful opportunities, the Chapel Outreach Coordinators strive to build Christian community through their relationships.

Job Location/ Hours Required

The candidate will perform most job duties in the Chapel Office, Hayworth Chapel, or on locations of open houses. Hours may vary depending on the job requirements; however, the total number of hours a student employee may work per week is 20 hours. This position requires between 5-10 hours per week.

Responsibilities

  • Staff Orientations and Open Houses
  • Outreach to interested prospective students, incoming students, and all students interested in Chapel programming
  • Build relationships through projects like: infinite space, advent and Lenten devotional, Wednesday chapel participation, and HPU Sunday messages and worship leadership.
  • Connect students to Weekly Chapel and/or HPU Sunday as the central witnesses to Christian worship on HPU’s campus.
  • Create meaningful fellowship opportunities
  • Organizing, reporting, and archiving (database) necessary information from visits
  • Updating and editing a Student Employee Operations Manual with step-by-step instructions based on your role and weekly tasks
  • Other duties as assigned

Expectations

  • Attend weekly chapel services and/or HPU Sunday
  • Wear business casual professional dress during work hours and any open house or orientation responsibilities
  • Represent CRL as well as develop, market, and enhance Chapel and Religious Life’s relationships on campus
  • Serve as a liaison between other campus ministries, Greek life, and/or other student organizations and offices/departments, as needed
  • Report back information gathered in a clear outline to present to CRL staff
  • Work independently, as a partner, and work together with the Manager of Chapel Programs, Minister to the University, and other Student Employees of the Office of Chapel and Religious Life
  • Work with the Board of Stewards on several projects
  • Serve at a limited capacity as an Office Assistant, when needed
  • Balance working with their academic responsibilities

Required Qualifications

Outreach Coordinators plan initiatives that have the dual purpose of attracting students and advancing the Chapel mission of increasing belonging, helping students become who they are called to be and behold God’s presence. Outreach Coordinators will meet interested students and follow-up with them in an authentic, comfortable, and open way. The coordinators will strive to understand students' interests, passions, and aspirations, and connect them to Chapel and Religious Life opportunities that the students may find meaningful and engaging.

Chapel Coordinators take direction from the Manager of Chapel Programs and the Minister to the University to communicate with the chapel community, student organizations, and students at High Point University. Tasks in maintaining outreach and creating support and partnership between the student body and Chapel and Religious Life will vary.

Desired Skills

  • Must have a minimum GPA 3.0 overall GPA
  • outgoing, friendly, professional, and inviting
  • interpersonal skills with ability to engage one-on-one to small and large group conversations communicate information effectively
  • Organized, with attention to detail
  • Excellent with Time Management

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper til nyt plejehjem i Klarup – få indflydelse på din vagtplan og vær med fra starten
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for et godt hverdagsliv for vores beboere?

Vi søger engagerede social- og sundhedshjælpere der brænder for høj faglig kvalitet. Hvis du kan se dig i det, så er det lige dig vi mangler!

Hos os vægter vi faglighed, samarbejde og et godt kollegialt fællesskab. Du vil møde smilende og engagerede kollegaer med plads til humor og latter. Læs mere om vores vision for plejehjemmet, indflytning og ansættelsesproces, helhedspleje, et hjertevarmt plejehjem og vores nye fællesskab på Klarup-plejehjem

Lidt om stillingen:

Der søges 6 medarbejder til faste stillinger som social- og sundhedshjælpere, med forventet ansættelsesdato den 1. november 2026.

Vi arbejder ud fra en helhedsorienteret tilgang, med udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske. Vi tror på at kontinuitet, nærvær og stærke relationer skaber den bedste pleje og høj livskvalitet for beboerne.

Vi kan ligeledes tilbyde:

  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab
  • En arbejdsplads hvor din faglighed gør en reel forskel

Vi tilbyder fleksible vagtformer, så stillingen kan tilpasses din livssituation:

  • Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer om ugen
  • Vagtform aftales i dialog med dig
Arbejdsområder:

Du vil få gode muligheder for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer via kurser, e-learning osv.

Faglige kompetencer:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper
  • Gerne med viden om demenssygdomme og deres indvirkning på adfærd og funktionsevne, herunder forebyggende tiltag
  • Arbejder ud fra personcentreret omsorg og inddrager borgerens livshistorie
  • Varetager grundlæggende pleje og omsorg med høj faglig kvalitet
  • Dokumenterer systematisk og fagligt korrekt
  • Har forståelse for relevant lovgivning, etik og magtanvendelse
Personlige kompetencer:

Som social- og sundhedshjælper får du en vigtig rolle i at skabe ro, tryghed og kontinuitet for vores beboere. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men er en del af et stærkt tværfagligt team.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Møder beboerne med empati, respekt og værdighed
  • Er rolig, tålmodig og nærværende – også i udfordrende situationer
  • Er observant og reagerer på små ændringer i beboerens tilstand
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat i en hverdag med skiftende behov
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå konstruktivt i et team
  • Har en reflekterende og professionel tilgang til pleje og omsorg

Arbejdsstedets adresse: Jørgensmindevej 15, 9270 Klarup

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte plejehjemsleder Lissi Kibsgaard Sørensen på tlf.: 9982 3585, 2957 4661 eller liks-aeh@aalborg.dk eller assisterende leder Kathrine Kondrup Rosland på tlf.: 2484 2986 eller kathrine.rosland@aalborg.dk for at høre mere om stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 31. august 2026 - Vi holder løbende samtale.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Forud for endelig ansættelse skal der foreligge en straffeattest og indhentes referencer.

Send ansøgning:

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder - Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.

Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: 인사이드 세일즈 매니저
description:
About

인연을 ​찾는 ​여정을 ​함께합니다.
우리는 사랑의 ​큐피트가 아니다. 셰르파다.

1. Who ​We ​Are: AI ​시대, 가장 인간적인 ​성장을 설계합니다
모든 ​것이 ​자동화되는 AI ​시대, ​역설적으로 ​사람들은 더 깊은 ​갈증을 ​느낍니다. 바로 '진짜 ​나'를 ​발견하고 ​누군가와 깊이 연결되는 ​경험입니다. 시라노는 ​단순히 ​만남을 주선하는 ​곳이 아닙니다. ​우리는 ​고객이 사랑에 도전하고 ​그 과정에서 ​스스로를 고도화할 수 있는 고객 성장 여정을 설계합니다.

2. Our Philosophy: 우리는 큐피트가 아니라 셰르파입니다
시라노는 사랑의 화살만 쏘면 사랑이 이루어진다는 유아적 연애관을 지양합니다. 현실의 인연을 찾는 과정은 때로 험난하고 용기가 필요하기 때문입니다.

큐피트가 아닌 셰르파: 우리는 히말라야 등반의 안내자처럼, 고객이 사랑이라는 목적지에 도달할 수 있도록 곁에서 길을 안내하고 무거운 짐을 나누어 드는 동반자가 되고자 합니다.
성장의 조력자: 경험과 조력자가 결합했을 때 일어나는 인간의 변화, 그것이 시라노가 정의하는 핵심 경쟁력입니다.

3. Business Impact: 실력으로 증명하는 압도적인 성장
시라노는 화려한 미사여구가 아닌, 시장에서의 실력과 숫자로 증명합니다. 외부 투자 없이 오직 제품력으로 부트스트래핑하며 압도적인 성장을 기록 중입니다.

별도의 대규모 마케팅 없이도 누적 가입자 10만 명을 돌파하며 유저들의 강력한 신뢰를 확인했습니다.
매년 전년 대비 2배 이상의 매출 성장(YoY 120%)을 기록하고 있으며, 현재 MoM(전월 대비) 400%라는 경이로운 속도로 시장을 장악하고 있습니다.
치열한 국내 데이팅/결혼정보 시장에서 단기간 내 Top 10 진입에 성공하며 브랜드 파워를 입증했습니다.
공격적인 확장 속에서도 창사 이래 매년 흑자를 기록하는 탄탄한 재무 구조를 갖추고 있어, 안정성과 성장성을 동시에 확보했습니다.

조직 문화
시라노의 성장은 개개인의 몰입과 건강한 문화에서 시작됩니다.

• 자유로운 질문과 존중: 직급과 관계없이 본질에 집중하는 질문을 지향합니다.
• 실패와 시도의 용인: 새로운 시도에서 얻는 배움을 성장의 자양분으로 삼습니다.
• 투명한 보상: 성과에 대해 약속된 보상을 반드시 지키며 투명하게 운영합니다.
• 함께하는 성공: 개인의 독주가 아닌, 협력을 통해 더 큰 파이를 만듭니다.

포지션 소개
"고객의 변화가 시작되는 첫 번째 접점"
시라노의 인사이드 세일즈 매니저는 망설이는 고객에게 확신을 주고, 전문 연애 컨설턴트와의 깊이 있는 대면 상담으로 연결하는 핵심적인 다리 역할을 합니다.
원활한 커뮤니케이션을 통해 고객의 니즈를 섬세하게 파악하고, 시라노 사무실 방문을 이끌어내는 퍼스트 컨택 전문가를 모십니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 접점 형성 및 1차 상담
• 인바운드 문의 고객 대응 및 유망 고객 대상 아웃바운드 콜 수행
• 전화 상담을 통한 고객의 연애 고민, 니즈, 현재 상황 1차 파악

2. 방문 상담 유도 및 스케줄링
• 시라노 대면 컨설팅의 가치 전달 및 방문 약속 확정
• 대면 연애 컨설턴트의 일정에 맞춘 효율적인 스케줄링 및 사전 리마인드

3. 고객 DB 및 노쇼 관리
• 상담 이력 데이터베이스 작성 및 최신화
• 부재 및 미방문 고객 대상 지속적인 재접촉 케어 및 노쇼 최소화 전략 실행

Requirements

• 관련 경력 1년 이상 (인사이드 세일즈, 인바운드/아웃바운드 콜 상담, TM, 고객 유치 상담 등)
• 전화를 통한 설득력 있는 목소리 톤과 탁월한 커뮤니케이션 능력을 보유하신 분
• 고객의 고민에 깊이 공감하면서도 목표(방문 유도)를 명확히 달성할 수 있는 실행력을 갖춘 분
• 거절 상황에서도 유연하고 긍정적으로 대처할 수 있는 멘탈 유연성을 지니신 분

Preferred

• 결혼정보회사, 웨딩, 뷰티/성형/피부과 상담실장 등 대면 방문 유도 세일즈/상담 경력자
• CRM 및 고객 관리 시스템 활용 경험이 풍부하신 분
• 아웃바운드 콜 환경에서 높은 방문 전환율(Conversion Rate)을 기록한 성과가 있으신 분
• 연애, 심리, 인간관계에 관심이 많고 타인에 대한 수용적 태도를 지니신 분

Benefits

• 유연 근무제 : 11시 ~ 13시 자율 출근
• 4대보험, 퇴직금, 연차
• 간식 제공
• 경조사비, 도서구입비 지원
• 최고/최신 업무 시설 (업무 환경 쾌적)

title: Rehabilitation Consultant | OT, EP Physio
description:
Altius was founded in 2001 with a simple aspiration; to drive new heights of workplace health and wellbeing. Since then, we've built a track record of expertise and positive impact in four critical service areas - PeopleSense Psychology & Wellbeing, Rehabilitation Services, Executive Health Solutions, and Workplace Health & Safety - that span the workplace wellbeing spectrum - still driven by a single goal: to elevate the wellbeing of people, workplaces and communities across Australia.

Requirements

YOUR NEW ROLE
Working from our as a Rehabilitation Consultant, you will play an instrumental role in facilitating the recovery and rehabilitation of individuals who have experienced injury, illness, or disability.

Your clinical expertise and guidance will be pivotal in supporting individuals regain independence, improve their quality of life, and reintegrate into the community and the workforce.

  • Develop personalised rehabilitation plans that support a whole-of-person approach to rehabilitation
  • Complete a range of assessments including Functional Capacity Evaluations, Workplace Assessments, Ergonomic Assessments and Activities of Daily Living Assessment (ADLS).
  • Use lateral thinking and forward planning skills to identify potential return to work pathways in line with likely recovery milestones
  • Utilise problem-solving skills, clinical experience, and knowledge of injury management to perform assessments and facilitate the return to work of claimants
  • You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders, including clients, their families, insurance companies, employers and other healthcare professionals to evaluate physical, psychological, and social factors
  • Present case information to various stakeholders and providing credible recommendations/solutions to drive the desired goal

Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO JOIN US

  • Full AHPRA Registration as Occupational Therapist or Physiotherapist, or ESSA Registration as an Exercise Physiologist
  • Tertiary qualification in Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy or Exercise Physiology
  • Current drivers' licence and access to own transport
  • Full Australian Working rights


WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US?

Unleash your potential:

  • You will join a market leader with over 20 years' experience of supporting people on their wellbeing journey
  • With multiple division and locations across Australia there are opportunities expand your horizons into new areas
  • Take control of your career development and progression pathway!
  • Support and training to empower you to manage your caseload effectively
  • Above award salary, generous bonus scheme, benefits, annual salary review.
  • Recognition of our people through national social award events & office-based awards.
  • Leadership training, mentoring, and guidance offered to reach your goals.



HOW TO APPLY

If Altius sounds like a place to be you click 'Apply Now'.

If you would like to have a confidential conversation before applying or if you're interested in a career with Altius but this role is not right for you, please email Simone Wong at swong@altius-group.com.au

Altius is an Equal Opportunity Employer and an inclusive workforce. Research has shown that, in Australia, women, people living with disability, LGBTQIA+, First Nations people, and those from minority groups are less likely to apply for a role because they feel they will not be successful. We believe in the strength of diversity and inclusion, and we would like to strongly encourage those who identify with any of these groups to apply for a role with us.

title: Junior / Senior Power Electronics Research Engineer
description:
About the Role:

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our Cloud Infrastructure Platform and Solutions (CIPS) Research Team. Our CIPS Research team is focused on developing future technology systems to support growth in the rapidly evolving data center sector. The successful candidate will be directly involved in early-stage research projects, working with academic institutions, suppliers, customers, and partners to deliver proof of concept designs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Fundamental Research – Complete literature reviews and studies to explore existing and future hardware topologies, components and control methods.
  • Ideation – Identify problems, future needs or market gaps to establish areas of interest.
  • Project Definition – Produce clear target requirements that the solution must meet.
  • Concept Proposal – Generate multiple potential design concepts and choose the best solution based on the defined requirements and feasibility analysis.
  • Proof of Concept – Create detailed designs, complete simulations and build test setups to demonstrate the technical feasibility of the proposed system.
  • Documentation – Write research reports, design guides, patents and performance reports.

Requirements:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics Engineering or related field.
  • Strong understanding of electronics hardware design and common power electronic architectures (AC/DC, DC/AC, DC/DC, etc).
  • Experience with architecture drawings, electronic schematics, component datasheets and PCB layout drawings.
  • Knowledge of embedded software (C/C++) and coding practices is preferred.
  • Hands-on prototyping and testing experience using oscilloscopes, electronic loads and power analysers.
  • Familiarity with SiC/GaN devices, magnetics design, EMI, and thermal management.
  • Expertise in using simulation tools to aid the development and assessment of the proposed solution (MATLAB, Python, Simulink, LTspice, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated passion for innovation and commitment to continuous learning.

title: Data Scientist, SMAI

description:
As a Data Scientist at Micron, you will employ techniques and theories drawn from areas of mathematics, statistics, semiconductor physics, materials science, and information technology to uncover patterns in data from which predictive models, actionable insights, and solutions can be developed.


You will interact with experienced Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Business Areas Engineers, and UX teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis projects and improvement of existing tools. In this position, you will help develop software programs, algorithms and/or automated processes to cleanse, integrate, and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources. There will be significant opportunities to perform exploratory and new solution development activities.

Primary Responsibility, but not limited to

  • Design, develop, and program methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyze unstructured, diverse “big data” sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product improvement.

  • Interact with product and service teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis and experiments.

  • Develop and code software programs, algorithms, and automated processes to cleanse, integrate and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources.

  • Deploy data science models and own the end-to-end life cycle, including solution design, development, deployment, model maintenance and monitoring.

  • Identify relevant insights from large data and metadata sources; interpret and communicate insights and findings from analysis and experiments to product, service, and business managers.

  • Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science or related fields.

  • Foundation in statistical modeling, advanced analytics, and modern machine learning techniques.

  • Ability to extract data from different databases via SQL and other query languages and applying data cleansing, outlier identification, and missing data techniques.

  • Proficiency with data visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI etc) and techniques.

  • Proficiency building interactive UIs using frameworks (Streamlit, React, Angular, or similar) based on UI/UX principles.

  • Proficiency in Python and other programming skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to effectively convey complex data insights to non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

  • Able to work independently and collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

  • Ability to apply baseline digital fluency and role‑appropriate AI literacy to use AI‑enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem‑solving, operational tasks, and achieving business outcomes.​

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS etc) and/or Cloud certifications.

  • Exposure to semiconductor industry.

  • Experience in web development.

  • Experience with generative AI and large language models (LLMs), including RAG, LLM tuning, and development of agents.

  • Contributions to top-tier conferences such as CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, or KDD (Note: This is not a research-focused role).

title: Senior Research Scientist - Pathology Image Analysis
description:
Job Description

Vertex Pharmaceuticals is seeking a highly motivated and collaborative Senior Research Scientist, Computational Pathology & Image Analysis to join the Histopathology team within Preclinical Safety Assessment (PSA) in Boston. This is a lab-based role focused on developing, applying, and troubleshooting image analysis workflows that support tissue-based assays across preclinical research programs.

PSA is responsible for the design and conduct of comprehensive nonclinical safety programs across all stages of discovery and development. In this role, you will support biomarker evaluation, and efficacy studies by generating high-quality image-derived data through the application of digital pathology and, quantitative image analysis, while helping the group evaluate emerging and AI-enabled tissue analytics approaches over time.

The successful candidate will be a technically excellent individual contributor who enjoys hands-on problem solving, workflow development, and high-quality delivery in a collaborative, service-oriented environment. You will develop and apply image analysis workflows for whole-slide brightfield and fluorescence imaging, including H&E, IHC, multiplex IF, RNAscope, and special stain assays, working. You will work closely with pathologists, histotechnologists, and cross-functional scientists to generate high-quality image-derived data that support preclinical and translational research programs.

Because Histopathology supports multiple discovery and development teams, this individual must be able to work independently, manage competing priorities, partner effectively with stakeholders, and deliver quality analyses on accelerated timelines. While this is not a dedicated AI or computational scientist role, the ideal candidate will bring curiosity and practical experience with computational pathology, AI/ML-enabled image analysis, computer vision, or other emerging digital pathology tools to help shape the future of the function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and troubleshoot image analysis workflows for tissue-based assays in a lab-based histopathology environment

  • Analyze whole-slide brightfield and fluorescence images, including H&E, IHC, multiplex IF, RNAscope, and special stain assays

  • Perform image review, annotation, segmentation, cell phenotyping, biomarker quantification, morphometric analysis, and quality control

  • Partner with pathologists, histotechnologists, and cross-functional scientists to interpret results and deliver fit-for-purpose analyses that support preclinical programs

  • Independently manage image analysis requests, prioritize work across multiple stakeholders, and deliver high-quality results in a timely manner

  • Contribute to dataset curation, annotation strategies, and evaluation of emerging AI/ML, computer vision, and automated image analysis approaches where appropriate

  • Introduce new techniques, tools, and best practices that strengthen digital pathology and image analysis capabilities within the Histopathology function

  • Summarize and communicate image analysis results to multidisciplinary teams through reports, technical presentations, SOPs, and workflow documentation

  • Develop and execute computational pathology and image analysis workflows for tissue-based assays

  • Perform image review, annotation, segmentation, cell phenotyping, biomarker quantification, and morphometric analysis

  • Support analysis of whole-slide brightfield and fluorescence images across preclinical studies

  • Partner with pathologists on image interpretation, QC, and pathology data review

  • Contribute to dataset curation and annotation strategies for machine learning and computer vision applications

  • Summarize and communicate image analysis results to multidisciplinary teams

  • Document workflows, results, and best practices through SOPs, reports, and technical presentations

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field (or equivalent degree) and 6 years of relevant employment experience, or

  • Master's degree in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field (or equivalent degree) and 6 years of relevant employment experience, or

  • PhD in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field (or equivalent degree) and 6 years of relevant employment experience, or

  • Typically requires 6 years of experience working in a research- or industry-based histology, pathology, digital pathology, or image analysis laboratory, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and applying image analysis workflows for whole-slide brightfield and/or fluorescence imaging

  • Knowledge of tissue-based assays, including H&E, IHC, IF, multiplex imaging, RNAscope, special stains, or related pathology methods

  • Experience with image review, annotation, segmentation, quantitative pathology workflows, biomarker quantification, or morphometric analysis

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a service-oriented, cross-functional environment

  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, adapt to changing scientific priorities, and apply sound judgment in developing fit-for-purpose analytical workflows

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and documentation skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field (or equivalent degree) and 6 years of relevant employment experience, or

  • Master's degree in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field (or equivalent degree) and 6 years of relevant employment experience, or

  • PhD in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field (or equivalent degree) and 6 years of relevant employment experience, or

  • Typically requires 6 years of experience working in a research- or industry-based histology laboratory or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • MS or PhD in Biological Sciences, Pathology, Biomedical Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Vision, or a related field

  • Significant relevant experience in digital pathology, image analysis, computational biology, or related research

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Preferred

  • Industry experience in biotech, pharma, CRO, or translational research

title: Community & Stakeholder Advisor
description:
• Tier 1 Construction & Utilities contractor

  • Permanent role with career progression

A rare opportunity to join a business that has been in operation for 90+ years and is focused on creating, connecting and caring for communities.

Life at Fulton Hogan is about making the most of opportunities, taking responsibility, and making it happen. We appreciate our peoples’ courage, curiosity and unique perspectives, and look to collaborate as much as possible to explore safer, smarter and more efficient ways of working in this rapidly changing world. We don’t stand still – there are always opportunities to do more and do better.

  • Keen to progress your career? Take full advantage of our tailored training, leadership, and mentoring programs; or leverage our partnerships with industry association such as Engineers Australia, the Australian Water Association, WaterAid, Chartered Accountants, CPA Australia, Infrastructure Sustainability Council, The National Association of Women in Construction, plus many more.

  • Looking to enhance your wellbeing? We will encourage you to explore flexible working arrangements where possible. We offer great benefits, including corporate health and fitness programs, health insurance discounts, personal banking support, a range of retailer discounts, up to 18 weeks paid primary carers parental leave and up to 10 days paid secondary carers leave, access to our Employee Assistance Program (including your immediate family), and the option to take more time for yourself throughout the year with our Purchase Leave Policy.

  • Want to help us better the communities we live and work in? Our purpose of creating, connecting, and caring for communities is more than a saying to us – it’s a way of thinking, working, and living because we're locals too, and seek to give back in ways that strengthen and build resilient communities. We do this because we genuinely care, enjoy what we do, and even manage to have some fun along the way! You’ll find us partnering with local and national community groups, like Clontarf Foundation, and Black Dog Institute, in addition to indigenous groups and social enterprises, to ensure that our good work positively impacts and brings about sustainable change within our industry.

  • Do we offer a ‘competitive’ salary package? Of course! Speak to our Talent Acquisition or People & Culture team to learn more.

What’s on offer?

We are looking to build on our existing team with a proactive and people-focused Community & Stakeholder Advisor to work on key water infrastructure projects for Fulton Hogan Utilities. This is a great opportunity to help lead meaningful engagement across a diverse range of projects. Working closely with the Communications Manager, project teams, contractors, councils, and community representatives, you’ll help ensure engagement is well planned, responsive, and aligned with program priorities.

In this role you'll be responsible for:

  • Lead stakeholder and community engagement across water and wastewater projects

  • Develop engagement strategies and provide advice on risks, issues, and opportunities

  • Build strong relationships with community groups, landowners, customers, councils, delivery partners, and regulators

  • Plan and deliver engagement activities including meetings, workshops, briefings, consultations, and targeted communications

  • Prepare high-quality engagement materials, reports, presentations, and correspondence

  • Monitor stakeholder sentiment and support responsive communication and decision-making

  • Contribute to improved engagement, communication, and reporting practices across the program.

How you'll connect to the role:

  • Experience in stakeholder and community engagement, ideally in water, infrastructure, utilities, construction, local government, or a similar environment

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence working with senior leaders, project teams, and external stakeholders

  • Sound understanding of engagement planning, consultation, issues management and reputation risk

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences

  • Confidence managing sensitive or complex issues with sound judgement and professionalism

  • Strong organisational, digital, and reporting capability, with a collaborative working style

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications are desirable, along with a commitment to Fulton Hogan’s Living Safely 2.0 culture.

Our people share the same set of values that keep us REAL. Respect, Energy and Effort, Attitude and Leadership encapsulate what we stand for at Fulton Hogan and encourage us to foster a diverse and inclusive culture where we listen to, care for, celebrate, and respect everyone.

We are committed to reconciliation and building and nurturing respectful relationships with First Nations peoples. Through our First Nations Engagement Strategy and Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), we aim to promote opportunities, cultural understanding and partnerships that celebrate and acknowledge the contributions of Indigenous communities.

If our values resonate with you, please submit an application for the position. If you’re not sure that you meet 100% of the selection criteria, that’s okay, we would still like to hear from you and potentially discuss how your skills could be utilised at Fulton Hogan.

For over 90 years, Fulton Hogan has been delivering high-quality infrastructure to improve the lives of people every day. Our 10,000+ team works in every kind of weather and environment, creating, connecting, and caring for communities across Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific.

Location: Budapest, Hungary

Working Model: Hybrid (2 days per week in the Budapest office)
Salary: HUF 1,045,000 – 1,567,500 gross per month (depending on experience)

About the Role

Hi, I'm Priyanka Mondal, QA Discipline Lead at Hawk-Eye Innovations.

I'm looking for a Full Stack SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) to join our QA team within the Video & Graphics Value Stream.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys building automation frameworks, improving testing practices, and working closely with engineers to deliver high-quality software.

You'll help drive quality across products that support sports broadcast graphics, video processing, cloud services, and data delivery platforms. Working with developers, product teams, and fellow QA engineers, you'll play an important role in improving reliability, scalability, and confidence in our software.

We're looking for strong experience in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, alongside UI automation, API testing, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS. Experience with Playwright is preferred, although experience with other modern automation frameworks is also welcome.


Key Responsibilities


Design and Develop Automation Frameworks

  • Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks across frontend, backend, desktop, API, and data-driven systems.

  • Establish testing patterns and best practices that support long-term maintainability.

UI and End-to-End Automation

  • Develop and maintain automated UI and end-to-end test suites using Playwright (preferred) or Cypress.

  • Work closely with developers to establish effective critical-path test coverage.

API and Backend Testing

  • Design and implement automated tests for APIs, backend services, and cloud-based applications.

  • Validate functionality, reliability, and performance across multiple systems.

Integrate Testing into CI/CD Pipelines

  • Embed automated testing into build and deployment workflows.

  • Support efficient and reliable software delivery through continuous testing.

Champion Quality

  • Help improve testing approaches, identify gaps, and promote quality-focused engineering practices.

  • Support teams in adopting scalable and effective testing strategies.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to align testing approaches with technical and business objectives.

Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing

  • Share knowledge through code reviews, framework discussions, and testing best practices.

Exploratory Testing

  • Perform targeted manual and exploratory testing where automation alone is not sufficient to uncover complex defects or edge cases.


Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Essential

  • Strong experience building automation frameworks using Python and JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience with Playwright or Cypress for UI and end-to-end testing

  • Experience testing REST APIs and backend services

  • Strong understanding of test design principles and maintainable automation patterns

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

  • Experience working with AWS cloud services

  • Strong debugging and analytical problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

  • Experience working within agile software development teams

Desirable

  • Experience testing video processing or streaming applications

  • Experience working with cloud-native or distributed systems

  • Exposure to computer vision, machine learning, or data-driven products

  • Knowledge of C++ and an interest in understanding backend systems

  • Experience testing desktop applications


The Team

Our QA team supports a broad range of technologies and products that power sports tracking, officiating, broadcast enhancement, graphics, video processing, and data delivery solutions.

Working closely with software engineers, computer vision engineers, machine learning specialists, product managers, and operational teams, we help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of systems used across some of the world's leading sports.

The team works across a variety of technical domains including:

  • Computer Vision

  • Video Processing and Streaming

  • Cloud Platforms

  • Data Science

This variety provides opportunities to develop new skills, gain exposure to different technologies, and contribute to products used by millions of sports fans around the world.


Team Culture

Our Engineering team is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared passion for innovation.

We encourage open communication, knowledge sharing, and ownership while maintaining a strong focus on quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. We value curiosity, teamwork, and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively in pursuit of building the best possible solutions.

As our products and technologies evolve, so do the opportunities for our engineers to develop new skills, broaden their experience, and grow their careers.

title: Product Owner
description:
Join Our Team as a Product Owner at Hawk-Eye Innovations


Hi, I’m Alison Marr, Product Lead for the Tracking and Auto Officiating Value Stream at Hawk-Eye Innovations. Are you interested in working with the latest technologies in a fast-paced environment, with exciting career opportunities in a growing business?

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our Value Stream delivers the tracking and automatic officiating services that have revolutionized global sport. From our world-renowned ball and object tracking systems to SkeleTRACK, our real-time skeletal tracking tech that powers Semi-Automated Offside Technology (SAOT) and electronic line-calling we turn live athletic movement into precise, high-stakes decisions and elite data insights.

We are looking for an experienced, highly autonomous Product Owner to take full ownership of a major product, platform, or technology across its complete lifecycle. At Level 4, you will step beyond day-to-day backlog management to actively shape short-to-medium-range roadmaps, define strategic OKRs, and manage complex stakeholder relationships with some of the biggest names in elite global sports. We need a technical, highly organised leader who can navigate ambiguity, make high-impact trade-off decisions, and drive consistency across our product portfolio while ensuring our solutions exceed the highest standards and strict customer SLAs.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Backlog & Scope Ownership: Serve as the definitive voice of the user, client, and business. Fully own the team backlog, defining epics, features, and user stories—and proactively handle complex dependencies and time-critical priorities to maximise ROI.

  • Roadmap, Vision & Market Strategy: Actively contribute to and shape the strategic roadmap and vision for our tracking portfolio. Research the market, track competitors, and perform deep user analysis to proactively propose improvements to system reliability, scalability, and UX.

  • Stakeholder Management & Ambiguity: Champion your product as its primary global ambassador. Lead high-level technical and business discussions, align cross-functional engineering teams, and successfully navigate complex, ambiguous environments to keep deliveries on track.

  • Quality & Built-In Engineering Excellence: Collaborate with Development Leads, Solution Architects, and QA to enforce common architectural patterns. Ensure built-in quality at every stage to completely eliminate the cost of delays (CoDs) associated with rework or recalls.

  • Operational Readiness & 3rd Line Support: Define success metrics and monitor operational data to guide business decisions. Oversee 3rd-line support within your product scope and guarantee that training, documentation, and testing are executed flawlessly ahead of rollout into BAU.


What We're Looking For

  • 2–3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner, demonstrating growing autonomy in managing all stages of the product lifecycle and leading short-range roadmap definition.

  • Advanced stakeholder management skills with a proven ability to align diverse cross-functional engineering teams, product leads, and high-profile external clients.

  • Strong technical grounding with concrete experience managing technically complex products and cloud-based data solutions.

  • Strategic product execution experience, particularly in defining Minimum Marketable Features (MMFs), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and setting clear OKRs.

  • Superb leadership and communication skills with a knack for removing product-related obstacles, conducting trade-off analyses, and keeping priorities visible.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience working on high-performance products within a business-to-business (B2B) setting.

  • Experience with real-time systems that combine cutting-edge software and hardware tracking infrastructure.

  • Enthusiasm for occasional international travel to collaborate directly with sports federations and teams trackside.


Benefits & Perks

  • Annual Leave: 25 days plus 8 public holidays

  • Enhanced Pension Scheme: 5% matching

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model (2 days in the office per week)

  • Wellness: Complimentary Unmind app, onsite gym (Basingstoke)

  • Exclusive Perks: Access to sporting events and tickets, Sony Group Company discounts

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. Everyone is treated fairly, regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or background. We want you to be your best and truest self here.


Apply Today

If you’re excited by the idea of handling high-stakes ambiguity, owning complex product lifecycles, and shaping the global future of sports tracking technology, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Professor of Practice: School of Design-Environmental and Interior Design
description:
PROFESSOR OF PRACTICE (Non-Tenure-Track) SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY, School of Design-Environmental and Interior Design/B.F.A.

SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY invites applications to fill a full-time, three-year renewable Professor of Practice position in Environmental and Interior Design (EDI) within the School of Design, College of Visual and Performing Arts. Our four-year program is accredited by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation (CIDA), and has consistently been ranked among the best programs nationally. This success is attributed to our community; our faculty are experienced and committed to supporting the success and growth of the students, and our students are engaged, curious, and passionate. Our graduates earn a Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) degree, and are eligible to take the NCIDQ Examination, the industry's leading credential for interior design licensure. This is a three-year position, beginning Fall 2026.

The successful applicant should have ample industry experience and the ability to teach a broad range of undergraduate courses core to the EDI curriculum, including: lecture-based courses that cover technical, structural, and building, accessibility, and life-safety code content, professional practice, courses that teach design technology and digital tools relevant to industry, and design studios. The candidate must have a deep understanding of interior design and the flexibility to work and teach collaboratively with a diverse set of colleagues within the program and across the School of Design. Ideally, the successful candidate will foster relationships with alumni, industry, and outside stakeholders.

Responsibilities of the appointment include teaching undergraduate courses each semester as assigned, but also supporting relevant programmatic initiatives, participating in program-related meetings, assisting with assessment-related documentation, supporting and advising students, developing projects that enhance the curriculum, engaging with curricular enrichment events (i.e. field trips, firm crawls), and demonstrating continued excellence in relevant professional activities.

The School of Design is an inquisitive and intelligent community of faculty and students who address issues in context. As a professionally-oriented academic unit in a large research university, the School is fully committed to forging bold, imaginative, reciprocal relationships with constituents who are local as well as global. As a top tier research institution, Syracuse University faculty and students are equally encouraged to interact with the academic core of the University.

With a long and distinguished history at Syracuse University, the School of Design currently offers several highly ranked undergraduate programs in addition to the Environmental and Interior Design (BFA) degree, including: Industrial and Interaction Design (BID), Fashion Design (BFA), and Communications Design (BFA), and Design Studies (BS). The School also houses a graduate program in Museum Studies (MA). Enrolling approximately 420 undergraduate and 30 graduate students, the School of Design occupies the Nancy Cantor Warehouse in downtown Syracuse. To learn more about the School of Design, please visit our website at

About The College of Visual and Performing Arts

The College of Visual and Performing Arts at Syracuse University is committed to the education of cultural leaders who will engage and inspire audiences through performance, visual art, design, scholarship, and commentary. We provide the tools for self-discovery and risk-taking in an environment that thrives on critical thought and action. To learn more about the college, our distinguished faculty, and our program, please visit our websites at , .
